240: Vayyihyu chayyi sara mea shana vesrim shana vsheva shanim, rabbi yose patach veamar, (Yona 1:15) vyyisu et yona vytiluhu el hayyam vyyaamod hayyam mizzapo. hacha it leistakkala, may tama arishat yamma aleh deyona, vla arishat aleh ara, kevan dehava azil begin dela tishre aleh shechinta, yamma (illaa) ammay achid beh kad hava azil.

Ela vadday milla beatreh hava. yam, tenan yam damya lerakia verakia lechisse hakkavod, uvegin kach yamma achid beh vental leh (begin dehava arik) mikkamme yama arak (nusach acher umikkamme yamma beh shara yire beducheteh), shade yamma yeda beh beduchetaha (nusach acher tishre yeda beduchetaha).

Vayyisu et yona vaytiluhu el hayyam. olifna kad havu natle leh vetave yarchoy beyamma, hava yamma shachich, zakfin leh, itreish yamma, kol ma detave leh hachi ishtechich yamma, ad deihu amar sauni vahatiluni el hayyam, miyyad vayyisu et yona vayyetiluhu el hayyam.
Kevan deitramme bayyam parcha minneh nishmateh, vesalka ad kurseyay demalka, veitdanat kammeh, veahadarat leh nishmateh, veal befuma dehahu nuna, umit nuna, levatar itkeyyaym hahu nuna, veukemuha.

Tosefta veyihyu chayye sara, gufa dematnitin anan kerevin havena shemana kala mithappech milleilla letatta etpashshetat bealma kal mittevar turen umetabbar tinnarin takkifin ilulin ravrevin salkin udenana petichan
Hava amar bimtallenoy kotz kotzita demichan demiyyemin shinta bechurehon kayyaymin bikyomehun malka demimmelal (vela iabbaru ishtechachu) natre tarin shellita dechilin saggiin kam bekiyyumeha
Kullehu la margeshan vela yadi desafra patiach uvishma echtov vedome kaem venatel bechushebana vedayyri afra tayyvin levar vekariv tav leitmena behu la teevin gilgola vahafoch

Naflin vela kayymin itmechun chayyayvin missifra dedome man yitba lon uman yatev bechushebanhon vave lon vave lichyayhon vavy lorogoshoyhvn (sefer acher lenafshihon) beginhun ittakkari (Tehillim 69:29) yimchu mispar chayyim vegomer:

Vayyihyu chayye sara. may shena hacha sara dichtiv mitata beorayyta mikkol neshe dealma dela ketiv hachi mitathon beorayyta. amar rabbi chiyay velav, vehachtiv (Bereshit 35:19) vattamat rachel vattikkaver bederech efrata. ukketiv, (Bamidbar 20:1) vattamat sham miryam vegomer. uchetiv, (Bereshit 35:19) vattamat devora

Midrash hanneelam vayyihyu. rabbanan patche behay kera, (Shir HaShirim 7:12) lecha dodi netztze hassade nalina bakkefarim. tanu rabbanan hayyotztze ladderech yitpallel shalosh tefillot, tefilla shehi chova shel yom. utefillat hadderech al hadderech shehu ose. utefilla sheyyachzor leveto leshalom. velema lehu lehanne shelosha, afillu beechad yachil lemebedeh, detaninan kol sheelotav shel adam yachil lemichlelinhu beshomea tefilla.

Amar rabbi yehuda kol ovadoy devar nash ketivin besifra, hen tav hen bish, veal kullehon atid lemittan dina, detaninan amar rav yehuda amar rav, may dichtiv, (Tehillim 139:16) galmi rau enecha, otam haddevarim sheasa haggolem sheeno mashgiach baolam habba, kullam rau enecha sheiyyaynta bahem. veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu, litten alehem din vcheshbon laolam habba, hilkach yakdim adam tefillato tamid veyoil leh.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak en adam ose averot ella mi shehu golem vlo adam, vehayeynu hahu dela mistakkal benishmata kaddisha, ella kol ovadoy kehay beira dela mashgachat vela yadat. amar rabbi bo, vechi golem mitkere davd deamar hay pesuka. amar lo rabbi yitztzechak adam harishon amaro, galmi
241: Ta chaze, beshata devar nash salik bearseh kol lelya velelya, nishmateh nafkat minneh veitdanat kamme be dina demalka, i zakkaa leitkayyma, ithaddarat lehay alma.

Vedina hu bitren gevavnin, deha la dayynin leh levar nash al bishin deihu atid vezammin lemebad dichtiv (Bereshit 21:17) ki shama elohim vegomer baasher hu sham. vela tema dedanin leh al tavin deavid lechud, ella leotava leh al inun tavin dehashta kema deittemar, vedanin leh al zachyayn deihu zammin lemebad, uveginayyhu ishteziv af al gav deihu hasheta chayyayva. begin dekudesha berich hu avid tivu im kol biryayn vechol archoy deihu avid leotava lecholla, vela dain levar nash al bishin deihu zammin lemebad, uvegin kach itdan bar nash kamme kudesha berich hu.

Ta chaze, kevan deattilu leh leyona beyamma, ma ketiv, vayyaamod hayyam mizzapo. hayyam illaa, may vayyaamod, dekaim bekiyyumeh kedka yeut, baamida ihu kad rugeza shachich, beshata dedina sharya bealma, hahu be dina ihu keitteta demitabbera, vekashya leolada, vechad olidat shechich rugeza. hachi name kad dina sharya bealma, la shachich vela nach ad deitavid dina bechayyayvaya, keden hu nayycha dileh, lemekam beducheta shelim, ulemekam bekiyyumeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 11:10) uvaavod reshaim rinna. veha okimna.

Baavod reshaim rinna. vehachtiv (Yechezkel 18:23) hechafotz echpotz mot rasha veha let nayycha kamme kudesha berich hu kad itavid dina berashshiayyay. ella kan kodem deishtelim kista, kan levatar deishtelim kista (it leh nayycha):

Rau enecha, kodem shezzarakta bi neshama, rau enecha lemebad bidyokni bene nasha dedamu li. veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu, man inun. yamim yutztzaru, kehay tzura didi. velo echad bahem dela ishtaar chad minnehon.

Amar rabbi bo, lamma. amar leh ta chaze, kullehu dedamu leh o birmiza dileh, la metu bemitat nafshehon, vechullehu laku behahu inyayna mammash. ta chaze, amar rabbi yehuda diukeneh deadam harishon veshappiruteh hava kezahara dirkia illaa deal gabbe shear rekie, uchehahu nehora deganiz kudesha berich hu letztzaddikayyay lealma deate, vechol inun dehavu remiza beh midiukeneh deadam harishon beh laku umitu.

Dechach orchoy dekudesha berich hu, yahiv utera levar inish, lamma, lemezan anayin ulemebad pikkudoy. la avid hay vitgae (vei itgalya beh) behahu utera, beh yilke dichtiv, (Kohelet Adonai:12) osher shamur livalav leraato. yahiv leh benin, lamma, lemelaf lehu orchoy dekudesha berich hu, ulemitar pikkudoy kidamur beavraham (Bereshit 18:19) ki yedativ lemaan asher yetztzavve et banav veet beto acharav veshamru derech Adonai laasot tzedaka vegomer. la avid hay umitgae behu, behu lake dichtiv, (Iyov 18:19) lo nin lo velo neched beammo vegomer. vechen kehay gavvna kad yahiv kudesha berich hu mishappiruta tava illaa deadam harishon lehu, lamma, begin lemitar pikkudoy ulemebad reuteh, la avdu keden ella itgau beh. beh laku behay shappiruta.

Amar rav yehuda, kad bara kudesha berich hu adam harishon, hava golem ad la zarik beh nishmata, vekara lehahu malacha dehu memunne al diukena divne nasha, veamar lo ayyen vetztzor bediukena deden shitta beni nesha, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit Adonai:3) vayyolled bidmuto ketztzalmo vayyikra et shemo shet, kelomar shitta.
Amar rabbi yitztzechak mehahu afra mammash deitbere adam harishon nasiv kudesha berich hu leitberaa illen shitta, vekara leh shet, shitta, hada hu dichtiv
242: Meneket rivka. uchetiv, (Bereshit 38:12) vattamat bat shua eshet yehuda.

Amar rabbi yose bechullehu la ketiv kema dichtiv besara deittemar vayyihyu chayye sara mea shana veesrim shana vesheva shanim shene chayye sara. deha bechullehu la itmanun yomin ushenin kemo lesara. bechullehu la ketiv parshata chada bilchudaha kemo lesara. ella raza ihu begin hahu darga dechol yomin ushenin devar nash beh talyayn (deda hi hei batraa).

Patach veamar, (Kohelet Adonai:8) veyitron eretz bakkol hi melech lesade neevad. veyitron eretz bakkol hi vadday deha mittamman nafkin ruchin venishmatin vetoalta lealma. melech lesade neevad, man melech da kudesha berich hu. lesade neevad kad ihu (77 2 ittakkan kedka yeot. umelech, da, melech illaa deitchabbar lisde kad ihu neevad. man sade, da sade asher barchu Adonai. dichtiv, 1) keriach sade asher beracho Adonai. dechad ihu (itavad) neevad veittakkan bechol ma deitzterich leh kedka yaot, keden melech illaa itchabbar immeh.

Rabbi elazar amar, melech lesade neevad. kamma gavvne razin illain hacha. melech. da (azav) shechinta dela sharya beveta leittakkana vah ella bezimna deitnasiv bar nash veizdavvavg beinteteh leolada ulemebad ibbin, veihi afikat nishmatin leashraa vah, uvegin kach lesade neevad vela leochora.

Davar acher melech da ishsha yirat Adonai kema deat amer, (Mishlei 31:30) ishsha yirat Adonai hi tithallal. lesade neevad da ishsha zara kema deat amer, (Mishlei 7:Adonai) lishmarcha meishsha zara. begin deit sade veit sade. it sade dechol birchaan vekiddushin beh sharyayn kema deat amer kereach sade asher beracho Adonai. veit sade dechol chiruv umesaavu veshetzaa vekatolin ukeravin beh sharyayn. vehay melech zimnin deihu neevad lehay sade dichtiv, (Mishlei 30:22) tachat shalosh ragza eretz

Vayyoled bidmuto ketztzallemo meotah haisa shennivra haggolem shello, veal kach neemar galmi rau enycha veiyaynt bo laasot (davar acher 33 bo) dedamu leh. veal sifrecha kullam yikkatevu, man inun, kullehu dela natru may deyahav kudesha berich hu lon veittardu min alma (veitdanu behahu dina).

Tenan hatam amar rav yehuda amar rav ashkachna ditlat mitran havi lelya, vechol chad vechad it inyayna dekudesha berich hu bevar nash. kad nafik nishmateh minneh vishtaar hahu golma naim al arseh, venishmateh salka bechol lelya kamme kudesha berich hu, amar rabbi yitztzechak i zakkaa hi chadan imma, vei la dachyayn lah levar. amar rav yehuda amar rav may dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim Adonai:8) hishbati etchem benot yerushalami im timtztzeu et dodi ma taggidu lo shecholat ahava ani.

Amar rabbi pinchas amar rabbi yehuda hishbati etchem benot yerushalam, hanneshama omeret leotam hanneshamot hazzochot likkanes lirushalam shel mala, vhem hannikraot benot yerushalami al shezzochot likkanes sham, ulefichach hanneshama omeret lahem hishbati etchem benot yerushalami im timtztzeu et dodi da kudesha berich hu. rav amar ze ziv aspaklarya shel mala. ma taggidu lo shecholat ahava ani, lehanot mizziv shello ulehistofef betztzillo. rav huna amar shecholat ahava ani, otah hatteshuka vehakkissuf shekkasafti baolam al hakkol lefichach ani chola. rabbi yehuda amar zo ahava sheohevet hanneshama lagguf, dechevn shennishlam kitztzo shel guf otam hayyamim shennigzeru alav kema deat amer vayyihyu chayye sara, ma ketiv vayyakam avraham meal pene meto vegomer.
Amar rav yehuda amar rav ma ketiv bappasuk kodem ze dichtiv vattamat sara bekiryat arba hi chevron beeretz kenaan.
Rabbi yitztzechak amar rabbi yochanan bara
243: Vegomer, tachat eved ki yimloch vegomer veshifcha ki tirash gevirtah. vehay melech itkasseya nehoreh veitchashshach ad deitdakke veitchabbar leela.

Uvegin kach sair derosh chodesh, begin deitperash hahu sade mimmalka kaddisha vela sharyayn behay sade birchaan mehay melech. vechad ihu neevad lehay sade keden ketiv, (Devarim 22:27) ki vassade metzaah vegomer. ki bassade kema deittemar.

Ta chaze, atat chavva lealma itdabbekat behay chivveya veattil vah zuhama. vegarma mota lealma ulevaalah. atat sara venachatat vesalkat vela itdabbekat beh kema deat amer, (Bereshit 13:1) vayyaal avram mimmitzrayim hu veishto vechol asher lo. ata noach lealma ma ketiv (Bereshit 9:21) vayyesht min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal vegomer.

Uvegin deavraham vesara la itdabbaku beh, vegin kach sara zachta lechayyin illain lah ulevaalah velivnaha batraa hada hu dichtiv (Yeshayahu 51:1) habbitu el tzur chutzavtem veel makkevet bor nukartem. veal da vayyihyu chayye sara dezachta behu bechullehu, vela ketiv bechullehu nashshe vayyihyu chayye chavva, vechen becholla, hi itdabbekat bachayyin, veal da dilah havu chayyin:

Tosefta zakkaa ihu man deazir garmeh behay alma. kamma ihu rav veillaa behahu alma. vehachi pattach rav metivta man deihu zeer ihu rav. man deihu rav ihu zeer. dichtiv vayyihyu chayye sara vegomer mea deihu chusheban rav ketiv beh shana, zeiru dishnin chad azir leh. sheva deihu chusheban zair asge leh vrabbe leh dichtiv shanim. ta chaze, dela rabbe kudesha bericha hu ella lidazir, vla azir ella lidrabbe. zakkaa ihu man deazir garmeh behay alma, kamma ihu rav beilluya lehahu alma. ad kan.

Man depasak yittepasak. man dekatztzar yittekatztzar. man dekatztzar yittearacha. retztzono lomar man depasak millin deorayyta al millin betelin yittepaskun chayyohi mehay alma vedinih kayyma behahu alma. man dekatztzar amen vla maaricha go nayycha yittekatztzar mechayyin dehay alma. man deamar echad itztzetricha lechatpa alef ulekatztzer karna dileh vla yeakkev behay ott kelal, uman deyaavid da yittearchun chayyav. (ellu hem chiddushim shehiggidu lerabbi shimon bar yochay bishiva shel maale), (74 kan hattosefta hasheyych ladef 122 amud bet)
Vayyihyu chayye sara. inun chayyin kullehu leela, mea shana leela. veesrim shana leela, vesheva shanim leela, kullehu havu kedka yeut. amar rabbi shimon

Kudesha berich hu laadam vehichnis bo arbaa devarim hannechelakim bagguf. amar rabbi yehuda hamechubbarim bagguf. rabbi yitztzechak amar hannecholakim bagguf shehem cholkim lehitparesh kol echad lisodo kesheyyotztze haadam min haolam hazze. rabbi yehuda amar hamechubbarim bagguf bechayyav, mashma mikra dichtiv vattamat sara, ze hagguf. bekiryat arba, ellu haarba yesodot. hi chevron, shehayu mechubbarim begufo bechayyav. beeretz kenaan, baolam hazze habbocher adam bizman muat:

Vayyavo avraham lispod lesara vlivkotah. hayeynu (dichtiv) ditnan kol shivat hayyamim nafsho shel adam pokedet legufo umitabbelet alav, hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 14:22) ach besaro alav yichav venafsho alav teeval. kehay gavvna vayyavo avraham lispod lesara velivkotah. vayyavo avraham, zo hi hanneshama. lispod lesara, ze hagguf.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak beshaa shehanneshama zocha veola limkom maalatah, hagguf shochev beshalom veyanuach al mishkavo hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 57) yavo shalom yanuchu al mishkevotam, holech nechocho. may holech nechocho. amar rabbi yitztzechak hanneshama holech nechocho limkom haeden hagganuz lah. may mashma. amar rabbi yehuda mehay mashma, nechocho ketiv, (lefanenu 20 boo 86 leel fag 2 bederech emet ot 3) beHei. uveshaa sheenah zocha vehi reuya lekabbel
244: Ta chaze raza demilla, may shena bechullehu deamar shana shana, uveinun sheva deamar shanim. dichtiv mea shana veesrim shana, ulevatar sheva shanim.

Ella kolla chad. mea shana kelala decholla (nusach acher kolla kachada beraza dameah birchan bechol yoma. vechen esrim shana deitkelil illaa setima dechol setimin, uvegin kach ketiv shana raza deyichuda). kudesha berich hu deitkelil meatar illaa setima dechol setimin bemea beraza demea birchaan dechol yoma, vechen esrim shana, uvegin kach ketiv shana raza deyichuda dela itperash (91 2) machashava veyovla lealmin.

Sheva shanim illen itparshan venafkan mikkelala setimaa dilela. veaf al gav decholla yichuda chada, aval mitparshan bedina verachame bechamma sitrin veorchin ma dela havi hachi leela. uvegin kach ketiv shana raza deyichuda dela itperash lealmin. sheva shanim illen itparshan bedina verachame bechamma sitrin veorchin ma dela have hachi leela. uvegin kach beillen sheva shanim ketiv behu shanim vela shana, vechullehu ikrun chayyim. vayyihyu chayye sara, dehavu mammash deitberiu veitkayyeymu leela.

Amar rabbi chiyyay ha ukemuha deha kad itakkad yitzchak bar telatin vesheva shanim hava, vechevan deitakkad yitzchak mitat sara, dichtiv vayyavo avraham lispod lesara velivkotah. meayin ba, mehar hammoriyya ba millemeekad leh leyitzchak, veinun telatin vesheva shenin miyyoma deityeylid yitzchak ad shata deitakkad inun havu chayye sara vadday kechusheban vayyihyu begimatriyya telatin usheva shenin havu kema deittemar middeityelid yitzchak ad deitakkad.

Rabbi yose patach veamar, (Tehillim 98:1) mizmor shiru laAdonai shir chadash ki niflaot asa hoshia lo yemino uzeroa kadsho. hay kera ukemuha chavraya, defarot amruha. kema dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 6:12) vayyishsharna happarot badderech. may vayyishsharna, dehavu amre shirata chadta. umay shira amru. mizmor shiru laAdonai shir chadash ki niflaot asa.

Hacha it leistakkala, dechol ma devara kudesha berich hu bealma kullehu amri tushebchan veshirata kammeh ben leela ben letatta, vei tema deinhu miggarmayyhu (davar acher 33 havo) amre shirata da, hachi hu vadday deraza illaa ihu, aval hanne, arona hava al gabbayyhu, vechevan daarona ishtekil alayyhu veshavyuha leela inun sheriru (nusach acher lo shechivu 40) shirata, deha kevan deitnetil minnayyhu arona havu gaan keorach shear parot dealma vela amru shirata. vadday arona
Onshah holechet meshomemet umevakkeret bechol yom lagguf velakkever.

Amar rabbi yose hay kulita dekardinuta, kad azil bisrichuta lechan ulechan azal umevakker lah leatrah teresar yarche. kach nishmata hahi deitchazzeya lekabbela ansha, azla levar bealma umafkedet la leatrah teresar yarche bevatte kivre uvealma.

Amar rabbi yehuda ta chaze, dichtiv vayyakam avraham meal pene meto vegomer, amar rabbi abba veha tenan dechad nishmata hi betashluma illaa, nittosaf bah Adonai venikret avraham betashluma illaa. vehacha at amer dechad leta zakkaa kol kach dichtiv vayyakam avraham. avdat man deyativ bekurseyay nachit bego zutar tattaa.

Ella hachi gazzarna vayyakam avraham meal pene meto, deamar rabbi bo amar rabbi zerika keshehanneshama reuya laalot limkom idnna, kodem megina al hagguf hakkadosh sheyyotztzet mishsham veachar kach ola limkom maalatah, hada hu dichtiv vayyakam avraham meal pene meto zehu hagguf.

Vaydabber el bene chet ellu shear gufot hatztzaddikim shehem (davar acher 33 bene) chattechattim venhelamim baolam lemaan yirat konam, chattim al shehem shochne afar, veammay tzericha lehu amar rabbi yehuda kolla beminyayna ketivin, veal (dahave davar acher da have hahu) gufa beminyayna immehon.
Uma amar lehu bederech piyyus uvederech kavod.
245: Mizmor. ha okimna, veittemar becholla ketiv mizmor ledavid o ledavid mizmor. vehacha la amar david kelal. ella mizmor deruach kudesha zammin lezammera leh lezimna deyokim kudesha berich hu leyisrael meafra. ucheden shiru laAdonai shir chadash, keden ihu chadash, deha shirata kehay la ittemar miyyomma deitbere alma.

Amar rabbi chiyyay ketiv, (Kohelet 1:9) en kol chadash tachat hashshemesh. vehacha shirata da ihi chadash veihi tachat hashshemesh, deha techot shimsha lehve. umay ihu da sihara, ucheden havi chadash tachat hashshemesh. may tama begin ki niflaot asa. uman inun niflaot, hay dichtiv hoshia lo yemino uzeroa kadsho. hoshia lo. leman

Ger vetoshav anochi immachem vegomer dehay gufa yehevi beminyayna chad immechon bechibbura da. amar rabbi ree ma ketiv vayyaanu bene chet et avraham vegomer. kemo chen bederech kavod bederech piyyus, hada hu dichtiv shemaenu adoni nesi elohim atta betochenu.

May nesi elohim atta. amar rabbi pinchas kodem sheyyitztze hatztzaddik min haolam, bat kol yotztzet bechol yom al otam hatztzaddikim began eden hachinu makom lifloni sheyyavo lechan. veal ken hem omrim meet elohim millemala atta nasi bechol yom betochenu, bemivchar kevarenu bemivchar hatztzaddikim hatztzaddikim bachavurat hammuvecharim mene oto hachenisehu becheshbon immanu, veish mimmennu lo yimna et hamminyan ki chullanu semechim bo umakdimim lo shalom.

Tosefta ribbi yose ben rabbi yehuda azil lemecheme lerabbi chiyyay, amar leh lema mar i shama hay parshatta hecha amru mare mattenitta depershuha beinyayna denishmatta. amar zakkaa chulakehon detztzaddikayya bealma deatte, dechacha hi orayyta belibbehon kemabbua rabba demaya, deaf al gav demastimin leh, misgiutt mayyay pattechi mabbuin denavin lechol evar.

Ta shema rabbi yose rechima at, ana ema lacha behay parshatta, leolam en guf haadam nichnas becheshbon hatztzaddikim al yad duma, ad shettare hanneshama pinkas simana shennottenin lah hakkeruvim baggan eden. amar rabbi yose ana shemaana deha nishmatta battar deayylatt tamman hi azlatt lesalka leattera leela vla lemechatt letatta, aval kodem shettaale vtikkanes naasett appatroppos hagguf al yad duma umara lo sherauy hu lekabbel sachar arba meott olamott.

Amar rabbi chiyyay ha rabbi elazar amar, deha duma yada kodem mishum demachreze alah beginta deeden. aval ana kacha shamana, di beiddana deyahavin (leh panekasea chazar al gufa laaayl leh befitka detzaddikayya al yedoy dedome. hada hu dichtiv ach im atta lo shemaeni natatti kesef hassade kach mimmenni. mahu kesef hassade, da kissufa dealmin arba meot deyahavin leh leachasana).

Rav yosef kad hava shama parshatta da mimmarehon dimtivta, hava amar, man deihu appera may ka (raykanea) zache lehay. man yizke uman yakum hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 24:3) mi yaale behar Adonai vegomer.

Amar rabbi abba ta chaze may dichtiv vyyishma avraham el epperon vyyishkol avraham leepperon ett hakkesef, da hu kisuppa rabbatta deinun almin vechisuppin. arba meott shekel kesef, arba meott olamott vehanaott vchisuppin. over lasocher. rav nachman amar sheyyaavor kol shaare shamayim vyrushalayim shel mala ven moche beyadah.

Ta chaze ma ketiv vachare chen kavar avraham ett sara ishto, vnimne im shear hatztzaddikim bachavurattam mippitteka dimmanna al yedoy deduma. amar rabbi yitztzechak hachi gemirna kol inun dichtivin bidoy deduma umemannan al yedoy yekumun lezimna dezammin leachaya dayyre appera. vavy lehon lerashiayya dela chetivin al yedoy bepitteka, sheyyovdu baggehinnam lealmin, veal da neemar (Daniel 12:1) uvaett hahi yimmalet imcha kol hannimtztza kattuv basepper, (74 kan tosefta)
246: Lehahu darga deamar shirata da, begin debhu istammich bimina uvismala. hoshia lo yemino, vadday lehahu darga dehay mizmor, ematay bezimna dikumun mete alma veyitarun meafra, keden yehe chadash ma dela itavid behay alma.

Rabbi yose amar bezimna deyaavid kudesha berich hu nukemin bealma beginayyhu deyisrael, keden yitamar shirata, deha levatar yitarun meafra mete alma veyitchaddesh alma bekiyyum shelim dela lehve (kekadmita deshallit mota bealma begin dechivya) (nusach acher karet umita bealma vayyitabber chivya mealma degarim) garim mota bealma lecholla veistaav alma veitchashich anpoy.

Ta chaze, ketiv, (Bereshit 3:15) veeva ashit bencha uven haishsha. may veeva kedichtiv (Iyov 9:26) chalfu im oniyyot eve. deha kamma arvin shatan go yamma rabba, veit arvin usefinan mitparshan da min da. veinun arvin dehay nachash shat begavvavyyhu ikrun oniyyot eva.

Bencha uven haishsha. da ishsha yirat Adonai. uven zarecha, illen shear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uven zarah, illen yisrael. hu yeshufecha rosh, da kudesha berich hu dezammin levaara leh mealma dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavt lanetzach. uchetiv, (Zecharya 13:2) veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz.

Rosh, da lezimna deate deyitarun metaya. deha keden leheve alma rosh, deyitkayyaym barosh deihu alma illaa. veatta teshufennu akev. da behay alma hasheta deihu akev velav ihu bekiyyuma vehahu chivya nashich lealma veachshich anpoy biryayn.

Ta chaze, yomin devar nash itberiu vekayymu beinun dargin illain, kevan dimsayymu leitkayyma beinun dargin dichtiv, (Tehillim 90:10) yeme shenotenu bahem shivim shana vegomer, mikkan ulehala let darga leitkayyeyma. uvegin kach verahbam amal vaaven. veinun kela havu.

Pazzi ta chaze, kevan shehanneshama pogaat bahem (vetadun), leachar kach pogaat leoto hammalach hamemunne alehem ditnan malach memunne al batte kivre veduma shemo, vhu machriz benehem bechol yom al hatztzaddikim haatidim likkanes benehem, umiyyad pogaat bo kede leshakken hagguf behasheket uvevitcha uvimnucha uvahanaa, (illaa) hada hu dichtiv vaydabber el efron.

Amar rabbi yisa ze hammalach hannikra duma, velamma nitkanne shemo efron, al shehu memunne al shochne afar. vehufekdu beyado kol pinkese hatztzaddikim vachavurot hachasidim hashshochnim beafar, vehu atid lehotztziam becheshbon.

Vetana amar rabbi elazar, leatid lavo kesheyyifkod hakkadosh baruch hu lehachayot hammetim, yikra lammalach hammemunne al hakkevarot, veduma shemo, veyitteva mimmennu minyan kol hammetim hatztzaddikim vehachasidim veotam gere hatztzedek veshennehergu al shemo, vehu motztziam becheshbon kemo shennetalam (Shemot 97 2) becheshbon, hada hu dichtiv (Yeshayahu 40:26) hammotztzi bemispar tzevaam vegomer ish lo nedar.

Vetana amar rabbi shemuel berabbi yaakov, nefashot harshaim netunot beyado shel malach ze sheshshemo duma, lehachenisam baggehinnam vladun sham, vechevan shennimsarot beyado, shuv enan chozrot ad sheyyikkansu laggehinnom, vez yirat david shennityayre kesheasa oto avon shenneemar (Tehillim 94:17) lule Adonai ezrata li kimat shachna duma nafshi. amar rabbi yisa hanneshama pogaat lo lehachenis oto guf im shear gufot hatztzaddikim becheshbonam hada hu dichtiv vaydabber el efron vegomer.

Amar rabbi tanchum hammalach kodem veomer lo. ree ma ketiv lemala veefron yoshev betoch bene chet, shichato lishkon beafar. vhu makdim veomer lo lehachenis oto hagguf becheshbon hatztzaddikim, hada hu dichtiv vayyaan efron hachitti et avraham beazne vene chet lechol bae shaar iro lemor. may lechol bae shaar iro. rav nachman amar inun
247: Havu veitkayymu kema deat amer vayyihyu chayye sara. vechen veelle yeme shene chayye avraham. vei tema hachi name ketiv beyishmael dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:7) shene chayye yishmael. ella bitshuva ahadar, veal da kare (beyomoy) vayyihyu:
Dealu bichtav chusheban pinkaseh, deamar rav nachman vehachi itgezar (al) cheshbon, al yedoy deduma alin bevatte kivre uvechusheban pitka zammin leafaka lon vehu memunne al dayyre afra.

Mahu hassade natatti lach vehammeara asher bo. amar rabbi yose hafekada deshalleva umenucha rabba. amar rabbi shalom bar minyume en lecha kol tzaddik vetztzaddik meotam haoskim battora sheen lo matayim olamot vechissufin bishvil hattora hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 8:12) umatayim lannotrim et piryo, umatayim al shemmosrim atztzemam bechol yom keillu nehergu al kedushat shemo, nitztzecho kehay pesuka (nusach acher vechach amro behay pesuka) dichtiv veahavta et Adonai vegomer. vetana kol hamechavin libbo behay pesuka kede limsor nafsho al kedushat shemo maale alav hakkatuv keillu neherag bechol yom alav, hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim ma) ki alecha horagnu kol hayyom. amar rav nachman kol hammoser nafsho behay pesuka nochel arba meot olamot laolam habba. amar rav yosef veha tenan matayim. amar rav nachman matayim al hattora, umatayim al shemmasar atztzemo bechol yom al kedushat shemo,

Vattamat sara bekiryat arba. rabbi abba amar kegavvna da la havu bechol neshe alma deha ittemar chusheban yomaha ushenaha vekiyyumaha bealma vehahu atar deitkavrat beh. ella leachazaa dela hava kesara bechol neshe alma.

Vei tema ha miryam dichtiv (Bamidbar 20:1) vattamat sham miryam vattikkaver sham. begin leachazaa sarchana deyisrael ka ata, deha mayay la azle lehu beyisrael ella bizchuta demiryam. aval la ittemar bemitatah kema deittemar besara.

Rabbi yehuda patach (Kohelet 10:17) ashrech eretz shemmalkech ben chorin vesarayich baet ychelu. hay kera (95 2) ukemuha chavrayay, aval it lan leistakkala beh, dezakkain inun yisrael dekudesha berich hu yahav lon orayyta leminda kol orchin setimin uleitgalleyay lon razin illain veha ittemar.

Ashrecha eretz, da eretz hachayyim, begin demalka dilah azmin lah kol birchan deitbarcha meavahan illain, raza devv deihu kayyma learka alah birchan tadir, veihu ben chorin ben yovela deappik avdin lecheru, bera dealma illaa deappik tadir kol chayyin vechol nehiru vechol meshach revut, vecholla aid (nusach acher angid) hay bera buchera lehay eretz kema deat amer (Shemot 4) beni bechori yisrael, uvegin kach ashrech eretz.

Uma deittemar i lach eretz shemmalkech naar kema deukemuha, dehay eretz tattaa vealma tattaa la yanka ella miggo shaltanuta (deella) dearla. vecholla mehahu malka deikre naar kema deukemuha. vavy leara deitzterich linaka hachi.

Midrash hannelam veavraham zaken ba bayyamim vegomer. matnitin. amar rabbi elazar al kol panim kach hu dehay matnitin shappir, deitavid nishmata hahu dichtiv beh (Yechezkel 1:15) vhinne ofan echad baaretz etztzel hachayyot learbaat panav. kidamur behahi matnita kammayyta.

Amar leh ribbi abba lema lan mar mehahi matnitin amar leh hachi itperash bitlat eser mechilan derachame befarshata dileh, aval hacha it lan lememar. patach veamar (Shir HaShirim 6:9) achat hi yonati tammati achat hi leimmah vegomer. amar ribbi elazar may hi deanan karinan hacha beshir hashshirim lishna denukevta, vehatam beorayyta lishna didchura.
Ela amar rabbi elazar hacha battora nikra belashon zachar etztzel hagguf mippene shehagguf etztzel hanneshama keishsha etztzel hazzachar,
248: Let leh migarmeh kelum bar kad natil birchan lezimnin yedian, vechol zimnin deitmenau minneh veitpegim sihara veitchashach uvirchan itmenau minneh, vavy lealma deitzterich linaka behahi shata. veod bechamma dinin itdan hay alma ad la yanka minneh, decholla bedina itkayyaym veitavad veukemuha (hachi).

Ta chaze, vattamat sara bekiryat arba. raza ihu, begin dela hava mitatah al yeda dehahu nachash akimaa, vela shalat bah kishar bene alma deihu shallit behu. veal yadeh metu bene alma miyyoma degarim lon adam bar mshe veaharon umiryam dichtiv behu al pi Adonai. uvegin yekara dishchinta la ketiv bemiryam al pi Adonai.

Aval besara ketiv bekiryat arba, raza dekiryat arba beraza illaa, vela al yeda ochora. bekiryat arba, velo benachash. bekiryat arba hi chevron, deitchabbar david malka baavahan, veal da la hava mitatah bida ochora ella bekiryat arba.

Ta chaze, kad yomin devar nash itkayymu bedargin illain, itkayyaym bar nash bealma. kevan dela itkayyaym bedargin illain, nafke venachate letatta ad dikrivu lehay darga demota sharya beh, ucheden natil reshu leappik nishmata vetas alma bezimna chada venatil nishmata vesaiv leh legufa veishtaar mesaava. zakkain inun tzaddikayya dela istaavu vela ishtaar behu mesaavuta.

Veta chaze beemtzaut dirkia itkattar chad orcha kasterira veihu chivya dirkia dechol kochavin dakkikin kulhu ketirin beh vekayyme beh tille tillin, veinun memannan bistiru (sefer acher basetayrav) ovade bene alma.
Kegavvna da kamma chavile tehirin nafke lealma mehay chivya illaa kadmaa deitpatta beh adam, vechulhu memannan bistiru ovade
Vehanneshama legabbe mala, kinkeva bifni hazzachar vechol echad maalato yoresh.

Tenan hatam bearbaa peamim (nusach acher bashshana) beshaa bechol yom, eden menatef al haggan, veyotztze meotam hatippot nahar gadol hammitchallek learbaa rashim, ushemone vearbaim tippot menatef bechol yom umishsham seveim ilane haggan hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:16) yisbeu atztze Adonai. rabbi tanchum amar mehacha (tehillim kav) mashke harim mealiyyotav, ezo hi aliyya zehu eden. veeden beeze makom hu. rabbi yehuda amar lemala mearavot hu. rabbi yose amar baaravot hu, deha tenan sham ginze chayyim tovim, beracha veshalom venishmatan shel tzaddikim vhagganuz haelyon hu eden, lemata mechuvn kengedo gan baaretz venotel mimmennu shefa bechol yom.

Amar rabbi abbahu shemona vearbaim neviim amdu lahem leyisrael vechol echad natal bechelko tamtztzit tippa achat meotam tippot shel eden shehem shemone vearbaim tippot. uma im kol navi shennatal tippa achat mehen hayta maalato beruach hakkodesh al kol hashshear. adam harishon shehaya mekabbel mishshemona vearbaim lo kol shekken, mikkan atta lamed kamma hayta chachmato.

Rabbi ba amar rav kahana vchi meayin haya lahem lanneviim meotam hatippot, ella hachi tenan, bechol tippa vetippa hayyotztzet meeden ruach chachma yotztze immo, veal ken itgezar bematnitin, it maya megaddelan chakkimin, veit maya megaddelan tippeshin, vinun maya dimgaddelan chakkimin inun maya havu mitippin deeden.

Deamar rabbi yose, maya deveh tippin yatvin (nusach acher yeterin) mikkol inun arba nahare kadmaa hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:11) shem haechad pishon. may shem haechad pishon. hameyuchad mikkullam pishon vhu hannofel beeretz mitztzerayim, ulefichach hayta chachmat (leyisrael) mitztzerayim yoter mikkol haolam.
Umishshennigzera gezira sheavda chachmat mitztzerayim, natal kudesha berich hu otam tippin vezarak lon
249: Alma, uvegin kach ate bar nash leitdakkaa, mesayyin leh milleela, vesiyyua demareh sachara leh veistammar veikre kadosh.

Ate bar nash leistaava, kamma chavilin tehirin izdammenu leh. vechulhu (sacharan) sharyayn beh umesacharin leh umesaavin leh veikre tame, vechullehu azle umachreze kamme, tame tame kema deat amer, (Vayikra 13:45-46) vetame tame yikra. vechullehu ketirin behahu chivya kadmaa usetirin bechamma ovade alma.

Rabbi yitzchak veribbi yose havu azle mitteverya lelod. amar rabbi yitzchak tevavhana al hahu rasha devilam dechol ovadoy dehahu rasha havu missitra dimsaava. vehacha olifna raza chada, dechol zine nechashayya dealma kullehon mitkatteran venafkin mehahu nachash kadmoni deihu ruach mesaava mezuhama, uvegin kach kol charashin dealma ikrun al shema da nechashim (veakrabbim) vechullehu mehay sitra nafke. uman deitmeshach behay, ha istaav.

Vela od ella devae leistaava begin leamshacha aleh hahu sitra deruach mesaava. deha taninan kegavvna deitar bar nash hachi name amshich aleh milleela, i ihu itar besitra dikdushsha amshich aleh kedushsha milleela veitkaddash. vei ihu itar besitra dimsaava hachi amshich aleh ruach mesaava veistaav. deha ittemar al ma detaninan ate bar nash leistaava mesaavin leh.

Begin kach hahu rasha devilam, begin leamshacha aleh ruach mesaava mehahu nachash illaa, hava istaav bechol lelya baataneh, vehava avid imma ovade ishut begin leistaava uleamshacha aleh ruach mesaava, ucheden avid chorashoy veovadoy.
Vesheruta deovadoy have natil nachash meinun chivyayn vekatir leh kammeh uvaza

Behahu ginna, behahu nahara deginta deeden dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) vnahar yotztze meeden lehashekot et haggan. vez haya molid arbaa acherim vehaechad hameyuchad hannolad mimmennu pishon haya. mishshennitlu ellu hatippot shello yatztzeu mehaggan avda hachachma mimmitztzerayim.

Umeoto haruach shehaya yotztze meeden, timtztzu (80 yimtzu) kol navi vnavi, vhayynu dichtiv mithallech baggan leruach hayyom. vganuz ze began eden leatid lavo, veze hu hannahar sheraa yechezkel binvuato. veal ken amar hakkatuv (Yeshayahu 11:9) ki mala haaretz dea et Adonai vegomer. sheotam mayim tamid megaddelim hayedia baolam.
Tanu rabbanan kol nishmatan shel tzaddikim lemala beeden hen. uma mimma sheyyored meeden yisge hachachma baolam, laomdim bo vnehenin mehanaotav vechissufav, al achat kamma vechamma.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak kevan shehanneshama zocha likkanes beshaare yerushalayim shel mala. michael hassar haggadol holech immah umakdim lah shalom. malache hashsharet temehim bo veshoalim aleha (Shir HaShirim 3:6) mi zot ola min hammidbar. mi zot ola ben haelyonim mehagguf hecharev sheddome lehevel dichtiv, (Tehillim 144:4) adam lahevel dama. hu meshiv veomer (Shir HaShirim 6:9) achat hi yonati tammati, achat hi meyuchedet hi. achat hi leimmah, leimmah zo hi kisse hakkavod shehi em lanneshama veyoledet lah shennigzera mimmenna.

Rauha banot vayashruha. ellu shear hanneshamot shehen bemaalatan lemala vehem hannikraot benot yerushalayim. amar rabbi yose ha chazarna al ma deamaran ellu nikraot benot yerushalayim, vehaacherot nikraot benot lot. rauha banot vayashruha. shear hanneshamot meshabbechot lah, veomrot shalom boech. melachot ufilaggeshim, melachot ellu haavot shehem melachot. ufilaggeshim, hen gere hatztzedek. kullam meshabbechot umekallesot otah ad shennichneset lemala, veazay hanneshama bemaalatah
250: Resheh veappik lishaneh venatil isbin yedian veokid kolla veavid minneh ketarta chada, levatar natil resha dehahu chivya uveza leh learba sitrin veavid minneh ketarta ochora.

Veavid iggula chad, vehava amar millin veavid ovadin ochoranin, ad deamshich aleh ruchin mesaavin, veodiin leh ma deitzterich, veavid behu ovadoy kefum ma deinun yade missitra dehahu chivya dirkia. mittamman itmashshach beovadoy vecharashoy ad deamshich aleh ruach mehahu nachash kadmaa.

Umehacha hava yada yedian vochorashin vekosmin. uvegin kach ketiv velo halach kefaam befaam likrat nechashim, nechashim vadday, veikkera vesharsha bimsaavuta ihu kema deittemar, ulevatar sheruta decholla lav ihu ella benachash.

Amar rabbi yose ammay kol zayyne chorashin vekosmin la ishtakkachu ella binshayyay. amar leh hachi olifna middaata nachash al chavva hittil bah zuhama, bah attil vela bevaalah. amar hachi hu vadday, ata rabbi yose uneshakeh lerabbi yitzchak, amar kamma zimnin shailna hay milla vela zachina bah ella hasheta.

Amar leh kol hanne ovadin vechol ma deyada bilam mean atar olif leh. amar leh meavoy. aval beinun harere kedem deihu eretz kedem olif kol chorashin vechol zine kosmin. (Shemot 112) begin divinun tvviri inun malache aza vaazael, deappil lon kudesha berich hu min shemaya veinun ketirin beshalshelae defarzela veodiin chorashin livne nasha, umittamman hava yada bilam kema deat amer min aram yancheni valak melech moav meharere kedem.

Amar leh veha ketiv velo halach kefaam befaam likrat nechashim vayyashet el hammidbar panav. amar leh, sitra tattaa deatya meruach mesaava dilela, hu ruach mesaava deshallit bemadbera kad avdu bene yisrael yat egla begin leistaava bahadeh deihu tattaa, uvecholla
Umitkayyeyma arichut hayyamim hada hu dichtiv veavraham zaken ba bayyamim. nichnas baarichut hayyamim laolam habba.

Rabbi abba sava kam al ragloy veamar, menucha veshalom garmin yehe lach rabbi shimon ben yochay dechazarat atara leyoshnah. detaninan bematnitta kadmaa dechevan shehanneshama hi betashlumah beatar illaa (lezimna batra alin) la tavat legufa, ella itberian minnah nishme ochoranin denafke minnah vihi ishtearat bekiyyuma, ad deata rabbi shimon ben yochay vedarash uma im baolam hazze shehu hevel vehagguf shehu tippa serucha nichneset bo otah hanneshama. leatid lavo sheyyitztzarfu kullam veyihye hagguf muvechar bekiyyum vetashlum yoter, eno din lehikkanes otah hanneshama bo bechol hattashlumin vhailluyin shebbah.

Amar rabbi acha otah hanneshama (bo bechol hattashlumin vhailluyin shebbah) mammash voto hagguf mammash atid hakkadosh baruch hu lehaamidan bekiyyuman leatid lavo, aval shenihem yihyu shelemim betashlum haddaat lehassig ma shello hissigu baolam hazze:

Veavraham zaken ba bayyamim vegomer. rabbi bo amar rabbi yochanan (beotam hayamim) beoto haolam shehu yamim, velo baolam hazze shehu layla. amar rabbi yaakov beotam haolamot shehem yamim beotam hahanaot vehakkissufin shehu nochel: vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol. beoto hammisra (nusach acher hammaaser) shennatan lo hakkadosh baruch hu mishshemo, shehi ot hei, shebbo nivra haolam.

Vetanya amar rabbi yochanan metatron sar happanim shehu naar eved merabbo haadon hammoshel alav, memunne al hanneshama bechol yom lehasepik lah meoto haor shennitztzetavva, vhu atid lemesav chusheban pitka bevatte kivre min duma uleachazaa leh kamme mareh, vhu zammin lemebad chamir hahu garma techot ara letakkana legufayay ulekayyma lon bishlemuta degufa bela nishmata (bezimna) dekudesha berich hu
251: Avad chorashoy begin deyechul leaakara lon leyisrael vela yachil.

Amar ribbi yose hay deamart bekadmita dechad nachash ata al chavva atil bah zuhama shappir, aval ha taninan dechad kaimu yisrael al tura desinay pasak minnayyhu zuhama. yisrael dekabbilu orayyta pasak minnayyhu zuhama, aval shear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot dela kabbilu orayyta la paska zuhama minnayyhu.
Amar leh shappir kaamart, aval ta chaze, orayyta la ityeyhivat ella lidchure dichtiv, (Devarim 4:44) vezot hattora asher sam moshe lifne bene yisrael. deha nashshe petirin mippikkude orayyta.

Veod deahadaru kullehu lezuhamatan kekadmita batar dechatu, veitteta kashya leitperasha zuhama minnah yattir miggavra. uvegin kach ishtakkachu nashin bacharashaya uvezuhama da yattir migguverin. deha neshaya missitra dismala ka atyayn veitdabbaku bedina kashya, vesitra da itdabbak behu yattir migguverin kema deittemar begin deatya missitra dedina kashya, vecholla itdabbak veazil batar zineh.

Ta chaze, dehachi hu kema daamina, devilam hava istaav bekadmita begin leamshacha aleh rucha mesaava. kegavvna da itteta beyome dimsaavu dilah it leh levar nash leistammera minnah, begin divruach mesaava itdabbekat uvehahu zimna i ihi taavid chorashin atzlachu bidaha yattir mizzimna ochora, deha ruach mesaava sharya imma, veal da bechol ma dekarivat istaav, kol shekken man dekariv bahadah. zakkain inun yisrael dekudesha berich hu yahiv lon orayyta veamar lon (Vayikra 18:19) veel ishsha beniddat tumatah lo tikrav legallot ervatah ani Adonai.
Amar leh hay man deistakkal betziftzufoy deofe ammay ikre nachash. amar lo deha mehahu sitra kaate deruach mesaava sharya al hahu ofa

Amar rabbi yitztzechak beotah shaa ma ketiv, vayyomer avraham el avdo zekan beto hammoshel vegomer. mahu el avdo, i bechachmeta da nistakkel mahu el avdo. amar rabbi nehoray lo nistakkel ella bamme sheamar avdo, avdo shel makom. (zaken beto) hakkarov laavodato, uman ihu, ze 314 kidkaamaran, deihu atid leyappot lagguf bevatte kivre.

Hada hu dichtiv vayyomer avraham el avdo, ze metatron avdo shel makom. (181 1) zekan beto, shehu techillat beriyyotav shel makom. hammoshel bechol asher lo, shennatan lo kudesha berich hu memshala al kol tzivotav.

Vetana amar rabbi shimon amar rabbi yose amar rav, kol tzivotav shel oto eved notlim or vnehenin mizziv hanneshama, detana or hanneshama laolam habba gadol meor hakkisse. vha mehakkisse nitla hanneshama. ella ze lefi harauy lo veze lefi harauy lo. rav nachman amar gadol meor hakkisse mammash dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:26) demut kemare adam alav milmala, may alav al zohoro.

Ucheshehu holech laasot shelichuto kol tzivotav vehammerkava shello nizzonin meoto hazzohar. hada hu shehanneshama omeret lo (dichtiv) sim na yadcha, kelomar siatcha, tachat yerechi, zehu or hannishpa min hanneshama alehem.

Amar rabbi yehuda berabbi shalom kach kibbalnu beshaa shezze holech bishlichuto shel makom, kudesha berich hu menia kol tzivotav shel mala beot achat mishmo. amar rav huna kach yerechi begimatriyya ram. kelomar hanneshama omeret sim na yadcha siatcha tachat maalato shel ram vnissa hammoshel al hakkol uleachar shetztzivva siat elyonim tachat yado ani mashbiacha shevua gedola bo.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak elohe hashshamayim vilohe haaretz. hoil veamar bAdonai shehu hakkol, lamma neemar elohe hashshamayim, amar rabbi yehuda shehu adon al hakkol, bevat achat uverega echad hu menia lakkol vechullam keayin
252: Veoda millin bealma. vechol ruach mesaava benachash itdabbaku veatyayn lealma velet man deyishteziv minneh bealma, deha ihu ishtakkach im kolla, ad zimna dezammin kudesha berich hu leaavara leh mealma kema deittemar dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) bila hammavet lanetzach umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kol panim vegomer. uchetiv, (Zecharya 13:2) veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz vegomer.

Ribbi yehuda amar, avraham yada behahi mearta simana, velibbeh ureuteh tamman hava, begin demikaddemat dena al letamman vechama leadam vechavva temirin tamman. umena hava yada deinun havu. ella chama diukeneh, veistakkal veitpattach leh chad pitcha deginta deeden tamman vehahu diukena deadam hava kaim legabbeh.

Veta chaze kol man deistakkal bediukena deadam la ishteziv lealmin mimmita, begin deha beshata devar nash istallak mealma chame leh leadam uvehahu zimna mit. aval avraham istakkal beh vechama diukeneh veitkeyyaym, vechama nehora denahir bimarta vechad sheragga dalik, keden taiv avraham diyyureh behahu atar, velibbeh ureuteh hava tadir bimarta.

Ta chaze, hasheta avraham bechachmeta avad bezimna detava kivra lesara, deha kad tava la tava limarta behahu zimna, vela amar devae leitparsha minnayyhu. ella amar, tenu li achuzat kever immachem veekbera meti millefanay. vei tema dela hava efron tamman. tamman hava, dichtiv veefron yoshev betoch bene chet, veavraham la amar leh behahi shata kelum.
Ella ma deamar lon, amar kema dichtiv vaydabber el bene chet vegomer. vechi salka datach deavraham baa leitkevra benayyhu ben mesoovin o detiuveteh hava immehon, ella bechachma avad.
Negdo. rabbi yitztzechak omer al shetayim otiyyot mishshemo lehorot shehu hakkol ven acher bilto:

Veashbiacha baAdonai elohe hashshamayim vilohe haaretz. amar rav huna vei havina immehon demare matnitta kad gillu raza dena la ifrashna minnehon hachi, deha ana chaze amikin saggiin befumayyhu degalu vela itchazzeyayn lechol enish. ta chaze, shevuat keyayma da ome lah nishmata dichtiv asher lo tikkach ishsha livni.

Amar rabbi yitztzechak mehacha mashma shehoil veatta holech bishlichut ze lo tikkach ishsha livni, kelomar shello tikkach guf livni (davar acher labenayyney) likkanes beguf acher beguf zar beguf sheeno rauy lo, ella behahu mammash shehu shelli, behahu mammash sheyyatztzati mimmennu, hada hu dichtiv ki im el artztzi veel moladti telech.

Amar rabbi yose mahu velakachta ishsha livni leyitztzechak. amar rabbi yitztzechak oto hagguf shennitztzetaer immi beoto haolam, velo haya lo hanaa vechissuf bo mippene yirat kono, oto hagguf mammash tikkach litztzechak immo behay simchat hatztzaddikim. litztzachek immo besimchat hakkadosh baruch hu, litztzachek immo deachshav et sechok baolam hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 126:2) az yimmale sechok pinu vegomer.

Amar rabbi yehuda bar yitztzechak ta shema en malach echad ose ela shelichut echad, velo 2 shelichut bevat achat. vetanya amar rabbi abba malach echad asher keset hassofer bematnav atid lehareshim kol echad veechad al mitztzecho, uleachar ken hassar haggadol holech letakken kol echad veechad ulehaamido lekabbel nishmato, hada hu dichtiv hu yishlach malacho lefanecha velakachta ishsha, may lefanecha lifne shelichutecha.
Rabbi (elazar) eliezer azal lemecheme lerabban yochanan ben zakkay rabbeh, vhahu yoma resh yarcha hava, kad mata gabbeh
253: Orach ara hacha bemma deavad avraham, deha begin detiuveteh ureuteh hava behahi mearta, af al gav dehava tamman, la baa lemishal leh miyyad hahu reuta dehava leh bimarta, veshail bekadmita ma dela itzterich leh leinun ochoranin vela leefron.

Kevan deamru leh kamme efron shemaenu adoni nesi elohim atta betochenu vegomer. ma ketiv veefron yshev betoch bene chet. yashav ketiv, mishsheruta demillin deamar avraham tamman hava. keden amar shemauni ufigu li beefron ben tzochar veyitten li et mearat hammachpela asher lo vegomer. vei tema begin yekara dili yattir minnayychu ana avid dela raena bechu. betochchem, begin leitkevara benayychu deraena bechu begin dela itperash minnayychu.

Rabbi elazar amar beshata deal avraham bimarta hech al. begin dehava rahit avatreh dehahu egla dichtiv veel habbakar ratz avraham vegomer. vehahu ben bakar arak ad hahu mearta veal avatrih vechama ma dechama.

Tu begin deihu tzalle kol yoma veyoma vehava nafik ad hahu chakal dehava salik rechin illain, vechama nehora denafik miggo mearta vetzalle tamman, vetamman mallil immeh kudesha berich hu, uvegin kach baa leh, detiuveteh hava behahu atar tadir.
Vei tema i hachi ammay la vaa lah ad hasheta, begin dela yishgechun aleh hoil vela itzterich leh. hasheta deitzterich leh, amar, ha shata lemitba leh.

Ta chaze, i efron hava chame bimarta ma dehava chame avraham bah, la yazbin lah lealmin. ella vadday la chama vah velo chelum, deha let milla itgalleya ella lemarih, uvegin kach leavraham itgalleyay vela leefron. leavraham itgalleyay dileh hava,
Lehakebil pene rabbo. amar leh lav al kach amarit. ella ana chame beanpach demilla chadta it gabbach meinun amikim deat atid lemitba.

Amar leh, chamena hay or harishon dematlanoy asara uvaasara natil, uveraza daasara nahig lecholla, uveatvavta daasara avid ovadoy. vetana asara pitkin asara maftechan deve katztzere bidoy, ufitkin asara natil beginta deeden leatkana ara al gufehon detztzaddikayya.

Amar leh eliezer beri chamit havit yattir mimmalacha kaddisha dealma, baasara itbere, baasara itnehig. baasara kurseyay kaddisha, baasara orayyta, hu baasara matlanoy, baasara almin illain (baasara) vechad illaa al kolla berich hu.

Veema lach milla dateh demare dematnitta hava behay ma ketiv vayyikkach haeved asara gemallim miggemalle adonav vayyilech. amar leh ribbi zachina lifsuka da, aval vechol tuv adonav beyado mahu. amar leh hu shemeh demareh deazil gabbe leaala leh uleanhaga (uleaggana) leh, amar da vadday hu ki shemi bekirbo.

Tenan amar ravi abbahu ta chaze, man deyada shemeh al bureyeh, yada dehu ushemeh chad hu, kudesha berich hu ushemeh chad dichtiv, (Zecharya 14) Adonai echad vegomer (kullehu) kelomar hashshem vehu echad.

Amar rabbi abba it leistakkala befarshata da: vayyavrech haggemallim michutz lair el beer hammayim. amar rabbi abba michutz lair, da hu be kivre. el beer hammayim, detanya hannikdamim bevatte kivre otam shennasu venatnu battora, deha tenan keshennichnas adam lakkever ma deshaalu leh techilla im kava ittim lattora dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:6) vhaya emunat ittecha vegomer. uchesheyyetztze eno din (lakeyymam) lahakimam battechilla.
Amar rabbi abba leet erev zehu yom shishshi shehu erev hashshabbat sheaz hazzeman lekayyma
254: Leefron la havat itgalleya leh dela hava leh chulaka beh. uvegin kach la itgeli leefron kelum, vela hava chame ella chashocha, veal da zabbin lah.

Uma dela tava avraham bekadmita deyazbin leh zavin, deha avraham la kaamar ella veyitten li et mearat hammachpela asher lo vegomer. bechesef male yittenenna li vegomer, veihu amar hassade natatti lach vehammeara asher bo lecha netattiha vegomer. begin decholla hava mais aleh deefron dela yada ma hi.

Veta chaze, kad al avraham bimarta bekadmita, chama tamman nehora, veitreme afra kammeh, veitgeli leh terin kivrin adhachi istallak adam bidiukeneh vechama leh leavraham vechayyech, uveh (hava) yada avraham detamman (hava) hu zammin leitkevara.

Amar leh, avraham, bematu minach, kusetra ketir it hacha. amar leh kudesha berich hu temaranni hacha umehahu zimna ad hasheta ittammarna kegilda dekirta ad daatit ant bealma, hasheta mikkan vaelach ha kiyyuma li ulealma hava beginach.

Chame ma ketiv vayyakam hassade vehammeara asher bo, kima mammash hava leh ma dela hava leh ad hasheta. rabbi abba amar vayyakam hassade, vadday kima mammash dekam veistallak kammeh deavraham begin dead hasheta la itchaze tamman kelum, vehasheta ma dehava tamir kam veistallik ucheden kam kolla benimmusoy.

Amar rabbi shimon beshata deal avraham bimarta veail sara tamman, kamu adam vechavva vela kabbilu leitkevara tamman, amru uma anan bechissufa kamme kudesha berich hu behahu alma begin hahu chova degarimna vehasheta yittosaf lan kissufa ochora mikkamme ovadin tavin divchu.
Amar avraham ha ana zammin kamme kudesha berich hu beginach dela tichsif kammeh lealmin. miyyad veachare chen kavar avraham et

Metayyay, may mashma ditnan shitta alfe shenin havi alma, vhu elef hashshishshi shehu siyyum hakkol, vehayeynu leet erev, zeman siyyum hakkol. leet tzet hashshoavot, ellu hem talmide chachamim hashshoavim memeha shel tora shehu et latztzet ulehitnaer min heafar.

Veamar rabbi abba od yish ladaat ditnan otam hammitassekim ladaat et boram baolam hazze venishmatam betashlumah laolam habba zachu latztzet mishshevuot hanneshama holech ladaat mi hu gufah mammash umay hu. hinne anochi nitztzav al en hammayim af al gav shettalmid chacham hu holech achar hattashlum, dichtiv vehaya haalma hayyotztzet lishov veamarti eleha hashekini na meat mayim mikkaddech emor li remez yediato mimma shehissagta.
Veamra elay gam atta shete, af atta eved (kamocha) kamoni velo nitchallef li (al) yediatcha bidiato shel makom baruch hu, vetztzarich atta lehassig sheatta nivra kamoni.

Vegam ligmallecha eshav, kelomar yediat hassagati shelo hissigu siatcha, veyadati ki maala yish li alecha vheach nivra atta mizziv hannatun etztzelcha. im hu omer siman ze yehi masur beyadi al kol devarim ellu, veeda shehi haishsha hu hagguf meotah hanneshama hashshevua shehishbiani:

Vayhi hu terem killa ledabber vegomer. ribbi yitztzechak amar ribbi yehuda beod shekkol hainyaynim hu rotztze lenassot al hagguf, may ketiv vehinne rivka yotztzet, zehu hagguf kadosh shennitassak bedivre tora vechittet gufo lehassig veladaat et kono. asher yalda livtuel, amar rav yehuda bitto shel el. ben milka, ben malkah shel olam. eshet nachor achi avraham. chevrat hassechel guf shennidbak bassechel vehi ach hanneshama. vechaddah al shichmah, massa hachachma aleha.
255: Sara ishto, may veachare chen. batar dekabbil avraham aleh milla da.

Adam al beducheteh chavva la alat, ad dekariv avraham veail lah legabbe adam vekabbil lah begineh, hada hu dichtiv veachare chen kavar avraham et sara ishto, lesara la ketiv ella et sara leasgaa chavva, ucheden ityayshvu beduchetayyhu kedka yeut, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:4) elle toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz behibbaram, vetaninan beavraham. toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz da adam vechavva. elle hashshamayim vehaaretz lo ketiv, ella toldot hashshamayim vehaaretz velo toldot bar nash. veinun itkayymu begineh deavraham. umena lan deitkayymu begineh deavraham. dichtiv vayyakam hassade vehammeara asher bo leavraham. vead deata avraham la itkayymu adam vechavva beduchetayyhu behahu alma.
Rabbi elazar shail leribbi shimon avoy, amar hay mearta lav ihu kafelta, deha ketiv mearat hammachpela, ukera kare lah levatar mearat sede hammachpela, machpela ka kare leh lassade.

Amar leh hachi kare leh mearat hammachpela kema deat amer veyitten li et mearat hammachpela, aval vadday chayyecha lav mearta ihu machpela. velav sade ikre machpela, ella hay sade umearta al shum machpela ikrun sede hammachpela vadday vela mearta, deha mearta bassade ihi, vehahu sade kaim bemilla ochora.

Ta chaze, yerushala 40 kol ara deyisrael itkappal techotah. veihi kayyma leela vetatta, kegavvna da yerushalam leela yerushala 40 letatta, achida leela veachida letatta, yerushala 40 leela achidat bitren sitrin leela vetatta (yerushalam letatta acheydetabetareyn sitrin leella vetatta) uvegin kach kafelta hi.
Veal da hay sade mehahi kafelta ihu deveh sharya. kegavvna da ketiv kereach sade asher beracho Adonai leela

Haggemiini na meat mayim mikkaddech, emor li remez chachmata bidiat borech mimma sheasakt baolam sheyyatztzat mimmennu. amar ribbi abba kidfarshinan, achar kol ze ma ketiv vasim hannezem al appah vehatztzemidim al ydeha. amar rabbi abba otam haatztzamot shennifzeru lechan ulechan, hu tzomed otam veshoklam ze al ze kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 58:11) veatztzemotecha yachlitz. amar ribbi abba beotah shaa oto hagguf omed beeretz yisrael vesham nichnas bo nishmato.

Amar ribbi yochanan mi molich hagguf leeretz yisrael, amar ribbi zera kudesha berich hu ose mechilot tachat haaretz vehem mitgalgelim veholchim leeretz yisrael hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) vertz refaim tappil.

Amar ribbi yitztzechak gavriel molich otam leeretz yisrael, mena lan dichtiv, (Bereshit 24:58) hatelchi im haish hazze, uchetiv hatam (Daniel 9:21) vehaish gavriel. amar ribbi yose may dichtiv ulerivka ach ushemo lavan. amar rabbi yitztzechak en yitztzer hara batel min haolam, af al pi shekkullo lo nimtztza ketztzato nimtztza.

Ta chaze, battechilla keshehaya mutal baolam hazze nikra lot, laolam habba (yibbadel) yibbatel min haolam, aval (leatid lavo) lo kullo, vnikra lavan lo menuval kevarishona ella keman desache minniuulo. lavan lemay itztzetrich. amar rabbi shimon lemebad periyya ureviyya itztzetrich, deamar rabbi shimon im en yetztzer hara nimtztza, periyya ureviyya eno matztzuy.
Ta shema kevan shehagguf nivna veomed bekiyyumo, may ketiv vayshallechu et rivka achotam vegomer. may (have) veet meniktah, ze koach hattenua. ribbi yitztzechak amar ze koach hagguf.

Ribbi abbahu patach behay kera (Shir HaShirim 4:8) itti millevanon kalla itti millevanon tavoi vegomer, amar ribbi abbahu kevan shehagguf nivne al kiyyumo umeviin oto lekabbel nishmato leeretz yisrael, hanneshama mamtenet elav veyotztzet likrato kema deat amer vayyetztze yitztzechak lasuach bassade. hada hu dichtiv itti millevanon kalla. zo hi hanneshama. tashuri
256: Vetatta, uvegin kach sede hammachpela vadday vela sade kaful.

Tu raza demilla sede hammachpela vadday, man machpela, Adonai devishma kaddisha deihi machpela. vecholla kayyma kechad, uvegineh kaamar beorach satim Adonai machpela dela have bishma kaddisha at ochora machpella bar ihi.

Veaf al gav dimarta chafelta hava vadday deihi mearta go mearta, aval al shum ochora ikre mearat sede hammachpela kema deittemar. veavraham yada, vechad amar livne chet kasse milla veamar veyitten li et mearat hammachpella, al shum deihi mearta kafelta, veorayyta la kare lah ella mearat sede hammachpela kedka yeut.

Vekudesha berich hu avad kolla leishtakkacha hay alma kegavvna dilela, uleitdabbaka da beda, lemeheve yekareh leela vetatta. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayya dekudesha berich hu itrae behu behay alma uvealma deate:

Veavraham zaken ba bayyamim vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol. rabbi yehuda patach (Tehillim 65:5) ashre tivchar utekarev yishkon chatzerecha, hay kera (94 amud bet) ittemar, aval zakkaa hu bar nash deorchoy itkashran kamme kudesha berich hu veihu itrae beh lekarava leh legabbeh.

Ta chaze, avraham itkeriv legabbeh vetiuveteh dileh hava kol yomoy behay, vela itkeriv avraham beyoma chada o bezimna chada, ella ovadoy kerivu leh bechol yomoy middarga ledarga, ad deistalak bedargoy.

Kad hava siv veal bedargin illain kedka chaze dichtiv veavraham zaken, ucheden ba bayyamim beinun yomin illain beinun yomin yedian beraza dimhemnuta. vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol. demittamman nafkin kol birchan vechol tivu.
Zakkain inun marehon ditshuva deha beshata chada beyoma chada beriga chada
Merosh amana, hayeynu dichtiv vayyissa enav vayyar.
Amar rabbi yehuda im hi hanneshama, tenach avraham kidkaamaran, aval yitztzechak mahu. amar rabbi abbahu ha chavrayyay amru deachshav itkere yitztzechak al shum chedvavta saggia divalma.

Amar rabbi abbahu battechilla nikret hanneshama avraham vehagguf sara, achshav nikret hanneshama yitztzechak vehagguf rivka. tenan bematnitin, amar rabbi shimon arbaim shana kodem kiyyum hagguf mamtenet hanneshama lagguf beeretz yisrael. beeze makom bemakom hammikdash.
Amar rabbi abbahu ta chaze, vayyikkach et rivka vattehi lo leishsha vayyeehaveha vayyinnachem yitztzechak achare immo. ohev leoto hagguf umitnachem immo, vhu et lischok vehachedva baolam.
Amar ribbi yehuda ha kol parshata da itberar lan, aval la yachilna leminda mahu: vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushemah ketura. uleshikkula dedata kol parshata da listure.
Kad ata rav dimi, amar, hay parshata da shamana vela idkarna, amru deillain takkifin la zimnuha legallaa vanan may nema. kam ribbi yehuda veamar mimtivta dechavrana mare matnitta galya.

Kamu veazlu hu vribbi yisa veribbi chiyyay, ashkechuha leribbi elazar beribbi shimon vehava megalle razin ditfillin. alu kammeh veamru bemay itassak mar. amar lon tama ditfillin amina, deha zakkaa hu bar nash demanach tefillin veyada tama didhu.

Amru i nicha kammeh demar lema lan milla. amru shemana meavuch dekudesha berich hu birchimu saggia dehava leh im yisrael amar lon lemebad leh be mashkena kegavvna dirticha illaa dilela veyete diyyureh immehon hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 25:8) veasu li mikdash veshachanti betocham. veshamana meavuch dehacha satim tama ditfillin behay
257: Kerevin legabbe kudesha berich hu, ma dela hava hachi afillu letzaddikim gemurim deitkerivu gabbe kudesha berich hu bechamma shenin. avraham la al beinun yomin illain ad dehava siv kema deittemar. vechen david dichtiv (Melachim 1 1:1) vehammelech david zaken ba bayyamim. aval marih ditshuva miyyad al veitdabbak beh bekudesha berich hu.

Rabbi yose amar taninan atar demarehon ditshuva kayyme beh, behahu alma, tzaddikim gemurim let lon reshu lekayyma beh, begin deinun kerevin lemalka yattir mikkullehu, veinun mashche alayyhu biruta delibba yattir uvechela sagya leitkerava lemalka.
Ta chaze, kamma atrin metukanin leh lekudesha berich hu behahu alma, uvechullehu be motve lon latztzaddikim. kol chad vechad lefum dargeh kedka chaze leh.

Ketiv, (Tehillim 65:5) ashre tivchar utekarev yishkon chatzerecha, dekudesha berich hu kariv lon legabbeh desalkin inun nishmatin mittatta leela uleitachada beachsantehon deittaknan lehu. yishkon chatzerecha, illen atrin vedargin levar, uman inun, kema deat amer (Zecharya 3:7) venatatti lecha mahlechim ben haomdim haelle. vehay hu darga ben kaddishin illain.
Uman dezakkain ledarga da, inun shelichan demare alma keinun malachin veavdin shelichuta tadir biruta demarihon, begin deillen (itkaddashu) tadir bikdushsha vela istaavu.

Kegavvna da, man deistaav behay alma ihu mashich aleh ruach mesaav, vechad nafak nishmateh minneh mesaavin leh umedoreh ben inun mesaavin veillen inun mazzikin dealma. kema deitmeshach bar nash garmeh behay alma hachi hu medoreh veitmeshach behahu alma (59 veinnun ruchi misave mesaavin leh veoolin leh laggehinnam.)
Ta chaze man deitkaddash venatir garmeh behay alma dela istaav. medoreh behahu alma ben inun kaddishin

Amar leh ta chazi, kegavvna illaa itavad mikdash birtichoy kaddishin, uvatar ken ashre kudesha berich hu diyyureh immehon, keinyayna da, uchegavvna da itaru chavrayyay mare matnitta betama ditfillin, lemehevi hahu gavra dugema dirtiche illain, reticha tattaa reticha illaa, lemete malchuta dileh veyashre diyyureh ilavi.

Vetaninan it beh razin illain vedugemehon, veit beh telat retichin, dugemat illain kaddishin razin ditlat atvavta dishmahan kaddishe, almin telat, retichin telata atvavta, arba parashiyyot shallit al arba, veal kach raza deshyn ditlat kitrin, 366 dearba kitrin, telata melachin shallitin begufa tefillin aloy kudesha berich hu leela, illen tefillin deresha, tefillin didroa arba parashiyyayn.

Libba rachiv dugema dirticha tattaa vetattaa rachiv. od taninan da rechiva didroa letatta. velibba rachiv, dugema deihu letatta veitmasserun bideh leaalaa lon kol chele shemaya, kach libba hu rachiv letatta vitmasseru bidoy kol evre gufa.

Veela minnih arba parashiyyayn al mocha deresha ihu, aval kudesha berich hu shallita illaa malka mikkolla. (veruach) vraza dechachmeta da, hu kegavvna demakdesha dichtiv vaase keruv echad mikkatztza mizze ucheruv echad mikkatztza. vealayyhu diyyureh demalka bearba atvavn teren retichin.

Uchehay gavvna libba umocha, libba mikkan umocha mikkan vealayyhu medoreh dekudesha berich hu bearba (davar acher arba) parashiyyayn. amar rabbi elazar mikkan ulehala raze dechitre atvavta ufarashiyyayn begufayyhu uretztzuotehon. halacha lemoshe missinay uremiza dilhon itgeli vetama decholla bitlat eser mechilan (derachame).
Amar ribbi yehuda ilmale la atena ella bedil raza da dayyay. amru leh zakkaa chulakach lealma deate dechol raz la anis lach. amru leh atena
258: Illain veavdin shelichuta tadir, veillen kayyme bachatzer kema deat amer, (Shemot 27:9) et chatzar hammishkan.

Veit ochoranin deinun lego yattir, delav inun bachatzer ella beveta kema deat amer, (Tehillim 65:5) nisbea betuv betecha. amar david nisbea betuv betecha, kevan deamar yishkon chatzerecha, ammay ketiv nisbea betuv betecha, yisba betuv betecha mibbae leh kema dichtiv yishkon. ella ha taninan let yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilchudayyhu.

Veit atar lachaside elyonin deayyle lego, umay inun, kedichtiv, (Bamidbar 3:38) vehachonim lifne hammishkan kedma lifne ohel moed mizracha moshe veaharon uvanav vegomer. vechamma madorin al madorin unehorin al nehorin mitparshan behahu alma, vechol chad ichsif minnehora dechavreh, kema deovadin itparshan behay alma hachi name duchetin unehorin mitparshan behahu alma.

Veta chaze ha ittemar deafillu behay alma kad bar nash naim al arseh, venishmatin itzterichu leitshotta bealma venafku miggo gufa, lav kol nishmata venishmata salka veshatya lemechoze bikar sever appe deattik yomin, ella kema deitmeshich tadir uchefum ovade hachi nishmateh salka.

I istaav ihu naim venishmata nafka vechol inun ruchin mesaavin naktin lah veitdabbekat behu beinun dargin tattain deshatyayn bealma veinun modiin lah millin deinun kerevin lemete bealma, ulezimnin demodin lah millin kedivan vechayychan bah veha ukemuha.

Vei zache bar nash kad ihu naim, venishmateh salka azla veshatya uvaka ben illen ruchin mesaavin, vechullehu machrizin veamrin, pannun atar pannun, lav da missitrana, veihi salka ben inun kaddishin umodae lah milla chada dikshot.
Vechad nachata kol inun chavilin terikin baan leitkerava bahadah leminda hahi milla, veinun modain lah millin ochoranin, vehahi milla denatla go inun kaddishin ben inun
Kammeh demar leminda raza dehay pesuka vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushemah ketura.

Amar perusha dehay pesuka kema degalu chavrana mare matnitin, dechad nishmata yete behahu gufa kaddisha dilah, ha milayyay havu al chayyayvaya dikumun vyichsherun ovadin veyitten lehu mizziva yekara dileh deyindeun vituvun veyizkun zechuta shelemata.

Vechad chama shelomo da hava sagge (davar acher tave saggi) veamar (Kohelet 8:10) uvechen raiti reshaim kevurim vvau umimkom kadosh yehallechu, sheyyavou veyichyu mimkom kadosh. vtaninan amar rabbi abba amar rabbi yochanan ketiv, (yirmeya 3) hayahafoch kushi oro venamer chavarburotav, kach harshaim shelo zachu lashuv baolam hazze ulehaktir maasim tovim laolam, lo yaktiru baolam habba. ree ma ketiv vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha, vesherotztze laasot lahem neshama legufam ulekarvam bitshuva, kema deat amer veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan.

Amar ribbi elazar ta chaze, ma ketiv vteled lo et zimran veet yakshan, harebe maasim raim ad shennigrashim min haolam dichtiv vayshallechem meal yitztzechak beno. vaalehem neemar (Daniel 12:2) verabbim mishene admat afar yakitztzu vegomer, veal haacherim neemar vehammaskilim yazhiru kezohar harakia vegomer.

Amar ribbi yehuda hay mashma al parshata, umashma deoto zeman (nikra) (sefer acher avad) avad shem (hanneshama) avraham, uvimkomo nikret ytztzechak kidkaamaran, hada hu dichtiv vyhi achare mot avraham vayvarech elohim et yitztzechak beno, vayyishev yitztzechak im beer lachay roi. im yediat hachay shehu chay haolamim ladaat ulehassig ma shelo hissig baolam hazze hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 11:9) ki mala haaretz dea et Adonai, (74 kan midrash hannelam)
259: Ochoranin ihu keibbura go tivna. vehay (man ihu dezache yattir beod deihu kaim venishmeta kayyeyma behay alma.)

Kegavvna da kad nafkin nishmatin miggufa mehay alma, baan lesalka, vechamma tarin chavile tehirin kayyme, (6) i inun missitrayyhu kullehu achadin behu beinun nafshan umasre lon bida deduma leoola lon baggehinnam.

Ulevatar salkan veachadan behu veinun natle lehon umachreze behu illen inun deavru al pikkude demarehon, vechen shatyayn bechol alma. ulevatar mehaddere lehu laggehinnom, vechen ad teresar yarche. levatar teresar yarche mishtakkeche behahu atar deitchaze lon. inun nishmatin dezachu salke leela kema deittemar vezachan beduchetayyhu.

Ta chaze, zakkain inun tzaddikaya deitgeniz lehu kamma tavin lehahu alma, velet atar penimaa bechol inun keinun deyade raza demarehon veyade leitdabbeka behu bechol yoma, al illen ketiv, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin la raata elohim zulatecha, yaase limchakke lo.

May limchakke lo, kema deat amer (Iyov 32:4) chikka et iyyov bidvarim. veillen inun dedachakin lemilla dechachmeta, vedayykin lah, umechakkan lah leminda berira demilla, veishtemoda lemarehon, illen inun demarehon mishtabbach behon bechol yoma, illen inun dealin ben illain kaddishin, veillen alin kol tare dilela velet man deyimche bidehon, zakkaa chulakehon bealma den uvealma deate.

Ta chaze, avraham al leminda uleitdabbeka bemareh kedka yaot levatar deakdim ovadoy bekadmita, vezacha beinun yomin illain, veitbarach meatar dechol birchan nafke mittamman, dichtiv vaAdonai berach et avraham bakkol. may bakkol. atar denahara dela paske memoy lealmin.

Amar ribbi chiyyay ta chaze, deavraham la baa leitarva binshe alma uleitdabbeka bishar amin ovde kochavim umazzalot, begin dinshayyay dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot inun saavin leguverayyhu uleinun demitdabbekin behon, begin dechad avraham yada chachmeta, yada ikra vesharsha umean atar nafke veshatyayn ruche mesaavin bealma, veal da ome leavdeh dela yissav itteta livreh mishshear ammin.

Ribbi yitzchak patach veamar, (Kohelet 12:7) veyashov heafar al haaretz keshehaya veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah. ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu laadam, natal afareh meatar demakdesha, uvana gufeh mearba sitrin dealma, dechullehu yahavu leh chela, levatar itrak aleh rucha dechayye kema deat amer, (Bereshit 2:7) vayyippach beappav nishmat chayyim vegomer levatar kam veyada deihu meela vetatta, ucheden itdabbak veyada chachma illaa.

Kegavvna da kol bar nash dealma ihu kalil meela vetatta, vechol inun deyadin leitkaddesha behay alma kedka yeut, kad olidu bar, mashchin aleh ruach kaddisha meatar dechol kaddishe nafkin minneh, veillen ikrun benin lekudesha berich hu begin degufa itavid bikdusha kedka yaot, hachi name yahavin leh rucha meatar illaa kaddisha kedka chaze veha ittemar.

Ta chaze, beshata dezammin bar nash lemehav chusheban ovadoy ad la yippuk mealma, hahu yoma, yoma dechusheban ihu, degufa venishmata yahave chushebna. levatar nishmata itparsha mineh, vegufa tav leara, vecholla tav leatreh deitnasiv mittamman veha ukemuha, ad zimna dekudesha berich hu zammin laachayay metayay kolla ganiz kammeh.

Vehahu gufa mammash vehahi nishmata mammash zammin kudesha berich hu leatava lealma kemillekadmin ulechadta anpe alma hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) yichyu metecha nevelati yekumun. vehahi nishmata mammash geniza kamme kudesha berich hu vetavat leatrah kefum archaha kema deat amer veharuach tashuv el haelohim asher netanah. ulezimna dezammin kudesha berich hu laachayay metayay, zammin ihu learaka talla merisheh alayyhu, uvehahu talla yekumun kolla meafra.
Hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 26:19) ki tal orot tallecha. may tal orot, orot mammash meinun nehorin dilela divhon zammin laaraka chayyin lealma, begin deilana
260: Dechayye yarik chayyin dela paskin lealmin, deha hasheta paskin begin deha chivya bisha shalta veitkasse sihara. uvegin kach kivyachol paskin memoy vechayyin la shaltin bealma kedka yeut.

Uvehahu zimna hahu yetzer hara deihu chivya visha yistallak mealma veyaavar leh kudesha berich hu kema deittemar (Zecharya 13:2) veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz. ulevatar deihu yitavar mealma, sihara la itkasya, venahara denagid venafik la yippaskun mabbuoy, ucheden ketiv, (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana keor hachamma veor hachamma yihye shivatayim keor shivat hayyamim vegomer.

Amar rabbi chizkiyya i tema dechol gufin dealma yekumun veyitarun meafra, inun gufe deitnetiu benishmata chada ma tehe minnayyhu. amar rabbi yose inun gufin dela zachu vela atzlachu hare inun kela havu, kema dehavu etz yavesh behahi alma hachi name behahu zimna, vegufa batraa deitneta veatzlach venatal sharashoy kedka yeut yakum.

Vealeh ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:8) vehaya keetz shatul al mayim vegomer vehaya alehu raanan vegomer. deavad ibbin venata sharashin veatzlach kedka yeut. veal hahu gufa kadmaa dela avad ibbin vela nata sharashin (velo zacha velo atzlach) ketiv, (Yirmeyahu 17:6) vehaya kearar baarava velo yire ki yavo tov vegomer. ki yavo tov da techiyyayt hammetim.

Veyitnehir hahu nehora dezammin leanhara lehu letzaddikayya dehava ganiz kammeh miyyoma deitbere alma dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:4) vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. ucheden zammin kudesha berich hu laachayay metayay, uchetiv, (Malachi 3:20) vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka vegomer, ucheden yitgabbar tov bealma, vehahu deitkere ra yitavar mealma kidamaran. ucheden inun gufin kadmae lehevo kella havu.

Amar ribbi yitzchak zammin kudesha berich hu laaraka alayyhu al inun gufin ruchin ochoranin, vei zachan behon yekumun bealma kedka yeut, vei lav yehon kitma techot raglehon detzaddikaya dichtiv (Malachi 3), uchetiv, (Daniel 12:2) verabbim mishene admat afar yakitzu vegomer. vecholla ittakam veitattad kamme kudesha berich hu, vechullehu beminyayna havu kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 40:26) hammotzi bemispar tzevaam vegomer.

Ta chaze, ha ittemar kol inun metin divara deyisrael yekumun bekadmita, begin dekudesha berich hu yitar alayyhu veyokim lon, alayyhu ketiv yichyu metecha, illen inun di veara deyisrael. nevelati yekumun, illen inun divgo aran ochoranin, dela ketiv behu techiyyay ella kima. deha rucha dechayye la tishre ella beara kaddisha deyisrael, uvegin kach ketiv behu yichyu metecha, veinun dilvar, yitbere gufa dilhon vikumun gufa bela rucha. ulevatar yitgalgelun techot afra ad deyimtun leeretz yisrael, vetamman yekabbelun nishmata, vela birshu ochora, begin deyitkayyeymun bealma kedka chaze.

Ribbi elazar veribbi yesa havu yatve lelya chad veaske beorayyta. amar ribbi elazar ta chaze, beshata dekudesha berich hu zammin laachayay metayay, kol inun nishmatin deyitarun kammeh kullehu kayymin diukenin diukenin kammeh behahu diukena mammash dehavu behay alma, venachit lon kudesha berich hu, veyikre lon bishmahan kema deat amer, (yeshaya noach) lechullam beshem yikra. vechol nishmata teol leduchetaha, vikumun bekiyyuma bealma kedka chaze, ucheden yehe alma shelim, veal hahu zimna ketiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) vecherfat ammo yasir vegomer, may vecherpat ammo yasir. da yetzer hara deachshich anpe biryayn veshallit behu.

Amar ribbi yose ha chaminan kol zimna devar nash kaim berucha da. lav ihu mesaav, nafka nishmateh minneh ihu mesaav. amar leh vadday hachi hu, vehachi ittemar deha hahu yetzer hara kad natil rucha devar nash saiv leh veishtaar gufa mesaav, ushear ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot kad inun bechayyehon inun mesaavin deha missitra missaava it lon nishmatin, vechad itrik minneh hahu mesaavu ishtaar gufa bela mesaavu kelal.
261: Man deitdabbak beitteta dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot istaav ihu. vehahu bera deityelid leh yekabbel aleh ruach mesaava. vei tema ha besitra deavoy miyyisrael ka atya, ammay yekabbel aleh ruach mesoova. ta chaze, deha bekadmita istaav avoy beshata deitdabbak behahi itteta deihi mesoova, vechevan deav ihu istaav behahi itteta deihi mesoova, kol shekken deihu bera deityelid minnah yekabbel aleh ruach mesoova. vela od ella deavar al orayyta dichtiv, (Shemot la) ki lo tishtachave leel acher, ki Adonai kanna shemo begin dekanne al hay berit kaddisha.

Amar ribbi elazar ta chaze deha ittemar dechevan deyada avraham avinu chachmeta baa leitperasha mikkol shear ammin vela leitdabbaka behu, uvegin kach ketiv veashbiacha baAdonai eloke hashshamayim viloke haaretz asher lo tikkach ishsha livni mibbenot hakkenaani vegomer, mibbenot hakkenaani vadday, (may) raza ihu kema deat amer (Malachi 2:11) uvaal bat el nichar. asher anochi yoshev bekirbo. anochi dayyka ketiv hacha asher anochi, uchetiv hatam (yeshaya 44 anochi asiti eretz. vechol da begin dela leistaava behu.)

Ta chaze, hay man deail hay berit kaddisha behahi itteta dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, garim leistaava atar ochora. veal da ketiv (Mishlei 30:21) tachat shalosh ragza eretz vegomer. veaf al gav deome leh behay berit, la avtach beh avraham ad detzalle tzeloteh kamme kudesha berich hu veamar Adonai eloke hashshamayim vegomer, hu yishlach malacho, vadday da malach habberit, begin deyitnetir hay berit vela yistaav ben inun ammin:

Rak et beni lo tashev shamma. may tama, begin deyada avraham deha bechullehu la hava man deishtemoda leh lekudesha berich hu bar ihu bilchodoy, vela baa delehvu medoreh deyitzchak benayyhu, ella dihe medoreh immeh, veyitzchak yolif minneh tadir archoy dekudesha berich hu, vela yiste limina velismala. veal da la baa avraham dilheve medoreh deyitzchak tamman.
Amar ribbi yesa vadday zechuteh deavraham oora kammeh dehahu avda, dehahu yoma nafak, vehahu yoma mata leena demayya, dichtiv vaavo hayyom el haayin. veha ukemuha.

Ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Tehillim 119:18) gal enay veabbita niflaot mittoratecha. kama inun beni nesha tippeshin dela yadin vela mistakkelin leishtaddela beorayyta, begin deorayyta kol chayyin vechol cheru vechol tuv bealma den uvealma deate. (hahu cheru dealma din vadealemaa deate ihu) (nusach acher hahu cheru dealma deate ihu chayyin bealma din). chayyin inun bealma den deyizkun leyomin shelemin behay alma kema deat amer, (Shemot 23:26) et mispar yamecha amalle. uleyomin arichin bealma deate. begin deinun chayyin shelemin, inun chayyin dechedu, chayye bela atzivu, chayyin deinun chayyin. cheru bealma den cheru decholla, dechol man deishtaddal beorayyta la yachlin leshaltaa aloy kol ammin dealma.

Vei tema inun beni shemad. gezera hi milleela kegon rabbi akiva vechaveroy, vechach salik bemachashava. cheru demalach hammavet dela yachil leshaltaa aloy, vehachi hu vadday dei adam hava itdabbak beilana dechayye deihu orayyta, la garim mota leh ulechol alma. uvegin kach kad yahav kudesha berich hu orayyta leyisrael ma ketiv bah charut al halluchot veha ukemuha. veilmale inun la chatu veshavku ilana dechayye, la garmu mota lealma kemilkaddemin. vekudesha berich hu amar (Tehillim 82:6) ani amarti elohim attem uvene elyon kullechem. chavaltun garmechon achen keadam temutun vegomer. veal da kol man deishtaddal beorayyta la yachil leshaltaa aloy hahu chivya bisha deachshich alma.
Amar rabbi yesa i hachi moshe ammay mit, dei hachi kevan dela chav la yemut (veammay yamut). amar leh vadday mit, aval la shalata beh kaamrinan, ella la mit al yedoy vela istaav beh, vela mit
262: Vadday ella itdabbak bishchinta veazil lechayye alma.

Vehay chay ikre, kema deokimna dichtiv (Shmuel 2:23) uvenayahu ben yehoyada ben ish chay vegomer. veal da kol man deishtaddal beorayyta cheru it leh mikkolla bealma den mishshibuda dishar ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. cheru bealma deate begin dela yitbeun minneh dina behahu alma kelal.

Ta chaze, beorayta kamma razin illain setimin it bah, begin kach ketiv, (Mishlei 3) yekara hi mippeninim. kamma genizin temirin it bah, veal da kad istakkal david berucha dechachmeta veyada kamma pelian nafkin meorayyta patach veamar, (Tehillim 119:18) gal enay veabbita niflaot mittoratecha.

Ta chaze, vayhi hu terem killa ledabber vehinne rivka yotzet. yotzet, baa mibbae leh, may yotzet. dekudesha berich hu appik lah mikkol inun bene mata dechullehu chayyayvin, vehi yotzet mikkelala dilhon. vattered haayna ketiv beHei, raza ihu deiarat tamman bera demiryam, uvegin kach ketiv haayna beHei useliku lah maya.
Davar acher vehinne rivka yotzet kema dichtiv yotzot lishov mayim, ammay yotzot velo holchot velo vaot. ella begin ditmirin havu kol yoma uvehahi shata nafkin leshaava maya, vesimana nakit bideh.

Ta chaze, kad mata avda lecharan veashkach lah lerivka leet erev hava idan tzelota demincha. behahi shata demata yitzchak letzallaa tzelota demincha, behahi shata mata avda legabbah derivka. uvehahi shata demata yitzchak litzlota demincha kemilkaddemin matat rivka legabbeh. leishtakkacha kolla beatreh deitzterich kedka yeut, vecholla mata beraza dechachmeta, veal da ata hahu avda liver hammayim raza dichtiv (Shir HaShirim 4:15) mayan gannim beer mayim chayyim venozlim min levanon, veokimna, vecholla raza ihu.

Ribbi shimon hava ate litverya vehava immeh ribbi abba. amar ribbi shimon leribbi abba nizil, deha anan chamenan devar nash chad yimte hasheta legabban umillin chadtin befumeh veinun millin deorayyta. amar ribbi abba ha yedana debchol atar demar azil, kudesha berich hu meshadder leh malachin tasin begadfin leishtashea beh.

Ad dehavu azle, salik ribbi shimon enoy, vechama bar nash dehava rahit veazil. yatvu ribbi shimon veribbi abba. kad mata gabbayyhu, amar leh ribbi shimon man ant. amar leh yuday ana umikkappotkiyya kaatina veana azilna atitreh devar yochay deitmannun chavraya bemillin yedian veshadderuni gabbeh. amar leh ema beri. amar leh ant bar yochay. amar leh ana bar yochay.

Amar leh ha okimna dela yafsik bar nash bitzloteh beneh leven kotla kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 38:2) vayyassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir vegomer. uman detzalle asir lemeevar arba ammot samich leh, veukemuha lehanne arba ammot lechol setar bar lekammeh. veukemuha dela yitzle bar nash achore rabbeh vechulei veitmannun bechol hanne mile.

Patach veamar, (Tehillim 39:13) shima tefillati Adonai veshavati haazina el dimati al techorash. may tama shima vela shema, beatar chad ketiv shema Adonai vechanini vegomer, uveatar ochora shima. ella bechol atar lezimnin shema lidchura ulezimnin shima lenukeva. shima kema deat amer, (Tehillim 17:1) shima Adonai tzedek vegomer. shema kema deat amer, (Tehillim 30:11) shema Adonai vechaneni. (Mishlei 1) shema beni. (Devarim 27:9) haseket ushema.

Vehacha shima tefillati Adonai, begin dehay (deihu) darga dimkabbela kol tzelotin dealma. veha taninan deavda minnayyhu atara veshavve lah beresha detzaddik chay olamim dichtiv, (Mishlei 10:6) berachot lerosh tzaddik. veal da shima tefillati Adonai.

Shima tefillati Adonai da tzelota di velachash. veshavati haazina da tzelota dearim bar nash kaleh beakteh kema deat amer, (Shemot 2:23) vattaal shavatam el haelohim. umahu shavatam, ella devitzloteh arim kaleh vezakif enoy leela kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 22:5) veshoa el hahar. utzelota da
