263: Metabbar tarin vedafik (saavadechayk) lon leaala tzeloteh. el dimati al techorash da, ail kamme malka velet tara dekaim kammeh, uleolam la ahadaru dimin berekanya.
Tu ha ketiv hacha telat dargin, tefilla. shava. dima. lokovel illen telat ochoranin. ki ger anochi immach. levatar toshav. levatar kechol avotay ikra dealma.

Ta chaze, tzelota devar nash meomed, begin ditre tzelota ninhu chad mioshshev vechad meomed, veinun chad lokovel teren dargin tefilla shel yad utefilla shel rosh. legabbe yom valayla vecholla chad. uf hacha tefilla mioshshev legabbe tefilla shel yad, leatkin lah kema (davar acher keman) deatkin lechalla vekashit lah leaala lechuppa, hachi name mekashtin lah beraza dirtichaa umashshiryayha, yotzer meshartim vaasher meshartav vehaofannim vechayyot hakkodesh vechulei.

Veal da tzelota meyushshav, kevan deoolat legabbe malka illaa veihu ate lekabbela lah, keden anan kayymin kamme malka illaa, deha keden (darga) dechura itchabbar benukeva, uvegin kach la yafsik ben geulla litfilla (ugeula 1, utefilla teren dargin inun, raza detzaddik vatzedek 156 244).

Uvegin devar nash kaim kamme malka illaa natal arba ammot litzloteh veukemuha divshiura (davar acher basheyavarea) desureta deyotzer kolla. vechol ma deate besitra didchura bae leh leinish lemekam vekiyyumeh veizdakkaf (sefer acher vayzadekaf). kegavvna da kad ihu korea, korea bevaruch, vechad ihu zakif, zakif bashshem, begin leachazaa shevacha didchura al nukeva.

Veta chaze deha ukemuha la yitzle bar nash achore rabbeh veittemar kema dichtiv, (Devarim 10:20) et Adonai elokecha tira. et leachlala devae lemidchal merabbeh kemora dishchinta, udechilu detalmid, rabbeh ihu. begin kach beshata ditzlota la yashve hahu mora lekammeh, (davar acher 33 litzlota) ella mora dekudesha berich hu bilchodoy vela mora ochora.

Veta chaze tzelota demincha atkin leh yitzchak. vadday kema deatkin avraham tzelota detzafra lokovel hahu darga deitdabbak beh. vechen (davar acher kach) yitzchak atkin tzelota demincha lokovel hahu darga deitdabbak beh. veal da tzelota demincha mechi nate shimsha lenachata bedargoy listar maarav.

Deha ad la nata shimsha letzad maarav ikre yom mitztzafra ad hahu zimna dichtiv, (tehillim 22) chesed el kol hayyom. vei tema ad chashecha, ta chaze, dichtiv (Yirmeyahu 6:4) oy na lanu ki fana hayyom ki yinnatu tzille arev. ki fana hayyom lokovel tzelota detzafra dichtiv chesed el kol hayyom, deha keden shimsha ihu listar mizrach, kevan denata shimsha venachata listar maarav, ha keden ihu zeman tzelota demincha uchevar pana hayyom veatu tzille arev veitar dina kashya bealma.

Ufana hayyom deihu darga dechesed, venatu tzille arev deinun darga dedina kashya, ucheden itcharav be makdesha veittokad hechala. veal da taninan dihe var nash zahir bitzlota demincha deihu zimna dedina kashya sharyay bealma.
Yaakov atkin tzelota dearvit deha ihu atkin lah vezan lah bechol ma deitzterich, vadday vav atkin leh, veh ittezanat min vav delet lah nehora miggarmah kelal.

Uvegin kach tefillat arvit reshut deha itkelilat bitzlota deyoma begin leitnahara, vehasheta lav zimna ihu. veokimna lah deha la itgalya nehora dimama deyanhir lah, veihi shalta bachashocha ad zimna defalgut lelya deishtasha kudesha berich hu im tzaddikaya beginta deeden, ucheden ihu zimna leishtashea bar nash (sefer acher ulemile) beorayyta kema deittemar.

Ta chaze, david ata veamar illen telat zimnin ditzlote dichtiv, (Tehillim 55:18) erev vavoker vetzohorayim ha telata, veihu la tzalle ella tere minnayyhu, dichtiv asicha veeheme, vela yattir. da litzlota detzafra veda litzlota demincha, begin kach asicha veehme dayyka. betzafra deihu shata dechesed sagge leh bechesed beasicha, uvemincha dehu shata dedina kashya bae hamayay uvegin kach veehme. ulevatar kad itpelig lelya hava kam beshirin vetushebchan kedka
264: Yaot dichtiv, (tehillim 62) uvallayla shiro immi veha ittemar.

Kam rabbi shimon veazlu. azal hahu var nash bahadeh ad teverya. ad dehavu azlu, amar ribbi shimon ta chaze, tefillot keneged temidin tiknum rabbanan deanshe keneset haggedola, begin deashkechan tere dichtiv, (Bamidbar 28:4) et hakkeves echad taase babboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim. veinun mitkarvin behanne tere zimne deyoma deinun zimnin litzlota.
Amar hahu gavra ha bekadmita avot tiknum lehanni tzelote, uma deatkinu avraham veyitzchak hu ikra, uma deatkin yaakov deihu shevacha deavahan ammay ihu reshut vela ikkera kehanne.

Amar ribbi shimon ha (229 2) ittemar. aval ta chaze, hanni tere zimne ditre tzelote lav inun ella lechabbera leyaakov beadveh, kevan deitchabbaru da beda anan la tzerichin yattir, dechevan deityehivat itteta ben teren deroin veitchabbarat begufa la itzterich yattir, veal da anan bainan leitara teren deroin begin deityehivat benayyhu, kevan deihi benayyhu, gufa veitteta millayyhu bilchishu dela leadkara.

Uvegin kach yaakov meshammesh bammarom taninan. may bammarom kema deat amer, (Tehillim 92:9) veatta marom leolam Adonai. vecholla ihu raza leyade middin. atu ribbi abba vehahu yuday uneshaku yedoy. amar ribbi abba ad yoma den la kaimna bemilla da bar hasheta. zakkaa chulaki dezachina lemishma leh:

Vayvieha yitzchak haohla sara immo. amar rabbi yose hay kera kashya. haohla. leohel sara immo mibbae leh, may haohela. daahadderat tamman shechinta, begin dechol zimna desara kayyma bealma shechinta la aade minah, usheragga hava delikat meerev shabbat leerev shabbat vehava nahir kol inun yome deshabbatta, batar demitat, kavta hahi sheragga. kevan deatat rivka ahaddarat shechinta usheragga adlikat. sara immo, dedamya lesara bechol ovadaha.

Ribbi yehuda amar kema dediukeneh deyitzchak hava kediukenih deavraham, vechol man dechame leyitzchak amar da avraham, vavday avraham holid et yitzchak, hachi name rivka diukkenah mammash havat diukena desara, uvegin kach sara immo vadday.

Amar ribbi elazar becholla hachi hu, aval ta chaze, raza ihu deaf al gav desara mitat, deyukena la aade min beta, vela itchaze tamman miyyoma demitat ad deatat rivka, kevan deoolat rivka itchaziat diukena desara, dichtiv vayvieha yitzchak haohla vegomer miyyad sara immo itchaziat tamman, vela hava chame lah bar yitzchak bilchodoy kad ail tamman, veal da vayyinnachem yitzchak achare immo (sefer acher may achare immo, achare) deimmo itchaziat veizdammena beveta, veal da la ketiv achare mitat immo, ella achare immo.

Ribbi shimon amar may shena dichtiv beh beyitzchak vayyikkach et rivka vattehi lo leishsha vayyeehaveha. kevan deamar vattehi lo leishsha la yedana dehu rachim lah, deha kol beni alma rachame linshayyhu. may shena beyitzchak dichtiv beh vayyeehaveha.

Ella vadday itaruta dirchimu didchura legabbe itteta lav ihu ella semala dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi. vechoshech velayla kechad inun, usemala itar rechimu tadir legabbe nukeva veachid bah, veal da af al gav deavraham (sefer acher hava) rachim lah lesara la ketiv beh vayyeehaveha ella beyitzchak. vei tema vayyeehav yaakov et rachel, sitra deyitzchak dehava beh koovid leh.

Ta chaze, avraham kad chama lesara (sefer acher lerivka) hava mechabbek lah vela yattir, aval yitzchak deihu baalah achid bah veshavve deroeh techot reshah dichtiv semolo tachat leroshi vimino techabbekeni. levatar ata yaakov veshimmesh arsa veolid teresar shevatin kolla kedka yeut.
Veta chaze avahan kullehu beraza chada
265: Azlu. vechullehu shimshu bearba nashin kol chad minnayyhu, avraham bearba sara vehagar utere pillagshim. dichtiv velivni happillagshim asher leavraham, pillagshim tere ha arba.

Yitzchak beraza dearba distiru derivka, dichtiv vayyikkach et rivka chad. vattehi lo leishsha tere. vayyeehaveha telat. vayyinnachem yitzchak achare immo ha arba. lokovel da havu leyaakov arba nashin. vecholla beraza chada.

Ribbi chiyay amar avraham veyitzchak shimmeshu kol chad beitteta chada beraza dekudesha. avraham besara, yitzchak berivka, velokovel tarvavyyhu have arba nashin leyaakov bitren chulakin. ribbi shimon amar seliku millin leatrayyhu. deha kolla beraza kaddisha itavad vecholla beraza chada:

Vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushemah ketura. ketura da hi hagar. deha taninan batar deitperasha hagar minneh deavraham vetaat batar gillule deavuha, levatar itkkashra beovadin dechashran, uvegin kach ishtanne shemah veikre ketura beovadin dechashran, veshadar avraham unesavah leh leintu. mikkan deshinnuy shema mechapper chovin, veal da ishtanne shemah.

Vayyosef avraham, may vayyosef, i tema deal sara ihu deosif, lav hachi. ella beyomaha desara izdavvavg bahadah zimna chada, ulevatar tarich lah al iske deyishmael, ulevatar vayyosef kemilkadmin zimna ochora al ma denasiv lah bekadmita. uchefum deshane ovadaha hachi name shane shemah.

Ta chaze, deamar rabbi elazar vayvieha yitzchak haohla sara immo. deitgalya diukena desara veyitzchak itnecham achare deitgalya immo, vediukenaha hava chame kol yoma. veavraham af al gav deinsiv la al behahu beta vela ail lah lehay itteta tamman, begin deshifcha lo tirash gevirta. uveohel desara la itchaze itteta ochora ella rivka.

Veavraham af al gav dehava yada dediukena desara itgalleyay tamman, shavkeh leyitzchak hahu ohel lemechome diukena deimmeh kol yoma. yitzchak vela avraham, hada hu dichtiv vayyitten avraham et kol asher lo leyitzchak. et kol asher lo dayyka, da hahu diukena desara behahu mashkena.

Davar acher vayitten avraham et kol asher lo leyitzchak, raza dimhemnuta illaa leitdabbeka yitzchak bedarga dechulakeh kedka yeut. ta chaze, hacha itkelil (saamaya beesha) esha bemaya, vadday esha natil maya, mashma vayyitten avraham et kol asher lo leyitzchak da maya deitkelil beesha. uvekadmita itkelil kechada esha bemaya. ematay, beshata deakad leh leyitzchak lemebad beh dina keden itkelil esha bemaya. vehasheta itkelilu maya beesha, lemehve kolla raza dimhemnuta illaa:

Velivne happilagshim asher leavraham natan avraham mattanot. may mattanot. illen sitre dargin tattain deinun shemahan desitre ruach mesaava begin leashlama dargin, veistallak yitzchak al kolla bimhemnuta illaa kedka chaze.

Bene happilagshim, illen havu bene ketura pillegesh bekadmita ufillegesh hasheta. rabbi chiyyay amar pilagshim mammash. vayshallechem meal yitzchak veno, dela leshalletaa legabbeh deyitzchak. beodenu chay, beod dehava avraham chay vekayyaym bealma dela yekatregun leh levatar, uvegin deyittakkan yitzchak bistar dina kashya illaa leittakkefa al kullehu, vechullehu itkafyayn kammeh. kedma el eretz kedem, begin detamman inun sitre chorashe mesaave.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Melachim 1 Adonai:10) vatterev chachmat shelomo mechachmat kol bene kedem. illen inun dehavu mibbene (inun) bene pilagshim deavraham, veha okimna deha beinun harere kedem inun deolfin chorashin livne nasha, umehahi eretz kedem nafku lavan uveor uvilam beno vechullehu chorashe veha ukemuha.
Ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 42:24) mi natan limshisa yaakov
266: Veyisrael levozzim halo Adonai vegomer. ta chaze, mizzimna deitcharav be makdesha birchan la sharyayn bealma veitmenau, kivyachol itmenau meela vetatta, vechol inun shear dargin tattain mittakfe veazle veshalte alayyhu deyisrael begin deinun garmu bechovayyhu.

Hay kera la ityayshvan milleh dichtiv mi natan limshisa yaakov, kevan deamar mi natan limshisa yaakov veyisrael, mahu chatanu lo, chatu lo mibbae leh, vei amar chatanu lo, may velo avu, velo avinu mibbae leh.

Ella beshata deitcharav makdesha veittokad hechala veamma itgeli, baya shechinta leitakkera midduchetah ulemehach immehon begaluta, amra ehach bekadmita lemechome betay vehechalay veefkod al duchete dechahane velevae dehavu falchin bevetay.

Amar ribbi elazar behahi shata istakkalat keneset yisrael leela vechamat devaalah istallak minnah leela leela, nachatat letatta alat beveta veistakkalat bechol inun duchete, veishtema kala leela leela veishtema kala letatta. hada hu dichtiv (Yirmeyahu 31:15) kol berama nishma nehi bechi tamrurim rachel mevakka al banyha vegomer veukemuha.

Kevan dealat begaluta istakkalat beama vechamat dedachake lon veramse lon begaluta ben raglayyhu dishar ammin, keden amrat (Yeshayahu 42:24) mi natan limshissa yaakov vegomer. veinun amrin halo Adonai zu chatanu lo. vehi amarat velo avu vidrachav haloch velo shamu betorato.

Uveshata dezammin kudesha berich hu lemifkad al ammeh, keneset yisrael tetuv min galuta bekadmita (amar leh kudesha berich hu) tehach leveta, vegin devet hammikdash yitbene bekadmita, veyema lah kudesha berich hu kumi meafra. hi tavat veamra lean atar ehach, betay charav hechali ittokad benura. ad dekudesha berich hu yivni be makdesha bekadmita veyatkin hechala veyivne karta diyrushala 40, ulevatar yokim lah meafra. hada hu dichtiv (Tehillim 147:2) boni yerushalayim Adonai vegomer. bone yerushalayim bekadmita ulevatar nidche yisrael yechannes, veyema lah (Yeshayahu 52:2) hitnaari meafar kumi shevi yerushalayim vegomer. veyitkannesh galutehon deyisrael. hada hu dichtiv bone yerushalayim Adonai, bekadmita, ulevatar nidche yisrael yechannes. ucheden harofe lishvure lev umechabbesh leatzvotam da techiyyayt hammetim. uchetiv, (Yechezkel 36:27) veet ruchi etten bekirbechem veasiti et asher bechukkay telechu vegomer. baruch Adonai leolam amen vamen: (ad kan parashat chayye sara)

Midrash hanneelam (Bereshit 25:19-20) velle toldot yitztzechak ben avraham avraham holid et yitztzechak. ribbi yitztzechak patach, (Shir HaShirim 7:14) haddudaim natnu reach vegomer. tanu rabbanan, leatid lavo hakkadosh baruch hu mechayye et hammetim vinaer otam meafram, shello yihyu binyan afar kemot shehayu battechilla shennivreu meafar mammash, davar sheeno mitkayyem, hada hu dichtiv (Bereshit 2:7) vayyitztzer Adonai elohim et haadam afar min haadama.
267: Shaashuim yom yom al tikre amon, ella uman.

Kad baa lemivre adam amra tora kammeh, i bar nash yitbere, ulevatar yechote veant tidun leh, ammay yehon ovade yedach lemaggana, deha la yechul lemisbal dinach. amar leh kudesha berich hu, ha atkinat teshuva ad la varati alma, amar kudesha berich hu lealma beshaata deavad leh uvara leadam, amar leh, alma alma, ant venimusach la kayymin ella al orayyta. uvegin kach barati leh laadam bach, begin deyitassak bah. vei lav, ha ana ahadar lach letohu vavohu vecholla begineh deadam kayyma, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 45:12) anochi asiti eretz veadam aleha barati. veorayyta kayyma umachreza kammayyhu divne nasha, begin deyitasseku veyishtaddelu bah velet man deyarchin udeneh.

Ta chaze, kol man deishtaddal beorayyta ihu kiyyem alma, vekiyyem kol ovada veovada al tikkuneh kedka yeut, velet lach kol shayyfa veshayyfa dekayyma beh bevar nash, dela have lekovleh beriya bealma. deha kema devar nash ihu mitpallig shayyfin, vechullehu kayymin dargin al dargin mittaknin illen al illen vechullehu chad gufa, hachi name alma, kol inun beriyyayn kullehu shayyfin shayyfin, vekayymin illen al illen, vechad mittaknan kullehu, ha gufa mammash. vecholla kegavvna deorayyta, deha orayyta kolla shayyfin ufirkin, vekayymin illen al illen, vechad mittakkenan kullehu, itavidu chad gufa. kevan deistakkal david beovada da, patach veamar, (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita mala haaretz kinyancha.

Beorayyta inun kol razin illain chatimin dela yachlin leitdabbaka, beorayyta kol inun millin illain, deitgalleyayn vela itgalleyayn, beorayyta inun kol millin dilela uletatta, kol millin dealma den, vechol millin dealma deate beorayyta inun, velet

Shaa yitnaaru meafar meoto habbinyan, veyaamdu bevinyan mekuyaym lihyot lahem kiyyuma, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 52:2) hitnaari meafar kumi shevi yerushalami, yitkayymu bekiyyuma. veyaalu mittachat laaretz vikabbelu nishmatam beeretz yisrael. beotah shaa yatztzif (nusach acher yashiv) kudesha berich hu kol mine rechin shebbagan eden alehem, hada hu dichtiv (Shir HaShirim 7:14) haddudaim natnu reach.

Amar ribbi yitztzechak, al tikre haddudaim ella haddodim, zehu hagguf vehanneshama shehem dodim vereim ze im ze. rav nachman amar, dudaim mammash. ma haddudaim molidim ahava baolam, af hem molidim ahava baolam. umay natnu reach, kishron maasehem ladaat ulehakkir levoram.

(Shir HaShirim 7) veal petachenu, ellu pitche shamayim shehem petuchim lehorid neshamot lifgarim. kol megadim, ellu hanneshamot. (Shir HaShirim 7:14) chadashim gam yeshanim, otam sheyyatztzeu nishmatam mehayyom kamma shanim, veotam sheyyatztzeu nishmatam miyyamim muatim, vezachu bechishron maasehem lehikkanes baolam habba, kullam atidim lered bevat achat lehikkanes baggufot hammuchanim lahem.

Amar rabbi acha bar yaakov, bat kol yotztzet veomeret, chadashim gam yeshanim dodi tzafanti lach. tzafanti otam beotam haolamot. lach, bishvilcha, bishvil sheatta guf kadosh vnaki. davar acher haddudaim (natnu reach) ellu malache shalom. natnu reach, ellu hanneshamot shehem reach haolam. natnu, shavku kema deat amer, (Bamidbar 21:23) velo natan sichon et yisrael.

Detana amar ribbi yehuda, shalosh kittot shel malache hashsharet holchim bechol chodesh uvechol shabbat lelauot lanneshama ad mekom maalatah. uveman nokim al petachenu kol megadim. amar ribbi yehuda, ellu hen haggufot shehem omdim befitche kevarot lekabbel nishmatan. veduma noten pitka dechushbena vehu machriz veomer, ribbono shel olam, chadashim gam yeshanim, otam shennikberu mikkamma yamim veotam shennikberu mizzeman muat, kullam tzafanti lach lemeppak lehu bechushebna.
268: Man deyashgach veyada lon, uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 106:2) mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato.

Ta chaze ata shelomo uvaa lemekam al milloy deorayyta, veal dikduke orayyta, vela yachil, amar (Kohelet 7:23) amarti echkama vehi rechoka mimmenni. david amar, (Tehillim 119:18) gal enay veabbita niflaot mittoratecha. ta chaze, ketiv bishlomo (Melachim 1 Adonai:12) vaydabber sheloshet alafim mashal vayhi shiro chamishsha vaalef. veha ukemuha. dechamishsha veelef teamim havu bechol mashal umashal dehava amar. uma shelomo deihu basar vadam kach havu bemilloy, millin deorayyta dekaamar kudesha berich hu, al achat kamma vechamma, debchol milla umilla it bah kamma meshalim, kamma shirin, kamma tushebchan, kamma razin illain, kamma chachman veal da ketiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv leela, (Bereshit 25:12) veelle toldot yishmael, deinun teresar nesiin, levatar amar veelle toldot yitzchak, salleka datach dechevan dichtiv beh beyishmael deolid terisar nesiin, veyitzchak olid teren benin, deda istallak veda la istallak. al da ketiv mi yemallel gevurot Adonai, da yitzchak, veyitzchak appik leh leyaakov dehava ihu bilchodoy yattir mikkullehu, deolid teresar shivtin, kiyyuma dilela vetatta. aval yitzchak leela bikdushsha illaa (sefer acher veyishmael) veesav letatta, veal da ketiv, mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato, da yaakov kad itdabbak shimsha besihara kamma kochvaya nehirin minnayyhu.

(Bereshit 25:19) veelle toldot yitzchak ben avraham. amar ribbi yose, may shena dead hacha la ketiv ben avraham vehasheta amar, ella af al gav dichtiv vayvarech elohim et yitzchak beno, hasheta demit avraham diukeneh hava beh, veishtaar beh beyitzchak, dechol man dechame leyitzchak hava amar da avraham vadday, vehava sahid veamar (Bereshit 25:19) avraham holid et yitzchak.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav, atid hakkadosh baruch hu lismoach beoto zeman im hatztzaddikim, lehasherot shechinato immahem vehakkol yismechu beotah simcha, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:31) yismach Adonai bemaasav. amar ribbi yehuda, atidim hatztzaddikim beoto zeman, livro olamot ulehachayot metim. amar leh ribbi yose, vehatnan (Kohelet 1:9) en kol chadash tachat hashshamesh. amar leh ribbi yehuda, ta shema, beod sheharshaim baolam veyirbu, kol haolam eno bekiyyum, ucheshehatztzaddikim baolam azay haolam mitkayyem. veatidim lehachayot metim kidkaamaran, (Zecharya 8:4) od yeshvu zekenim uzekenot birchovot yerushalam veish mishanto beyado merov ymim, kedichtiv leel. (114 amud bet)

Beoto zeman, yassigu hatztzaddikim daat shelema, deamar ribbi yose, beyoma deychede kudesha berich hu beovadoy, zeminin inun tzaddikaya leminda leh belibbehon, ucheden yisge suchletanu belibbehon keillu chazu leh beena, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:9) vamar bayyom hahu hinne elohenu ze vegomer. vsimchat hanneshama bagguf yeter mikkullam, al sheyyihyu shenihem kayyaymim veyidu veyassigu et boram vyhenu mizziv hashshechina, vezhu hatov hagganuz latztzaddikim leatid lavo. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:19) velle toldot yitztzechak ben avraham, ellu hem toldot hassimcha vehassechok sheyhe baolam beoto zeman. ben avraham, hi hanneshama hazzocha lechach velihyot shelema bemaalatah. (Bereshit 25:19) avraham holid et yitztzechak, hanneshama molida hassimcha vehassechok hazze baolam.

Amar ribbi yehuda leribbi chiyyay, ha detaninan deatid hakkadosh baruch hu laasot seuda latztzaddikim leatid lavo, may hi. amar leh, ad la azlit kamme inun malachin kaddishin mare matnitin hachi shemia li, kevan deshamit ha deamar ribbi elazar, ityshsheva belibbay, deamar ribbi elazar, seudat hatztzaddikim leatid lavo, kehay dichtiv (Shemot 24:11) vayyechezu et haelohim vayychlu vayyishtu, veda hu ditnan nizonin. veamar ribbi
269: Lemile beorayyta, verabbi yehuda kam bekesaroy, behahi shata. amar rabbi yehuda, ekum veezil legabbe rabbi yitzchak, veile beorayyta venitchabbar kechada. azal immeh chizkiyya berih dehava ravya. kad kariv abbava, shama leh leribbi yitzchak dehava amar, vayhi achare mot avraham vayvarech elohim et yitzchak beno vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi, hay kera lav resheh sefeh velav sefeh resheh, may shena dekudesha berich hu itzterich levarcha leh leyitzchak, begin deavraham la beracheh. may taama, mishshum dela yitbarech esav, veal da seliku inun birchan lekudesha berich hu, veukemuha. vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi, may lachay roi, ella deitchabbar vah bishchinta, bera demalach kayayma itchaze alah, ketargumo, uvegin kach beracheh.

Adhachi, batash rabbi yehuda abbava veal, veitchabbaru. amar rabbi yitzchak, hasheta ziuuga dishchinta bahadan. amar ribbi yehuda, hay beer lachay roi dekaamart shappir, aval bemilla ishtema. patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 4:15) mayan gannim beer mayim chayyim venozlim min levanon, hay kera ittemar aval ha ukemuha, mayan ganim da avraham beer mayim chayyim da yitzchak, venozlim min levanon da yaakov. beer mayim chayyim da yitzchak, hayeynu dichtiv vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi. umay beer da shechinta. lachay, da chay haolamim, tzaddik chay haolamim velet leafrasha lon, chay hu bitri almin, chay leela, deihu alma illaa, chay legabbe alma tattaa, vealma tattaa begineh kayyma venahara.

Ta chaze, sihara la itnehirat, ella kad chazya leh leshimsha, vechevan dechazya leh, itnehir. veal da hay beer lachay roi vadday, ucheden itnahara, vekayyma bemayin chayin, lachay roi, begin leitmalleya uleitnahara mehay chay.

Elazar beatar chad taninan nehenin, uveatar ochora taninan nizonin, may ben hay lehay. ella hachi amar avoy, hatztzaddikim shello zachu kol kach nehenin meoto ziv shello yassigu kol kach, aval hatztzaddikim shezzachu nizzonin ad sheyyassigu hassaga shelema. veen achila ushetiyya ella zo vezo hi hasseuda vehaachila. umena lan ha, mimmoshe, dichtiv, (Shemot 24:18) vayhi sham im Adonai arbaim yom vearbaim layla lechem lo achal umayim lo shata. may taama lechem lo achal umayim lo shata. mippene shehaya nizzon misseuda acheret meoto ziv shel mala, uchehay gavvna seudatan shel tzaddikim leatid lavo.

Amar ribbi yehuda seudat hatztzaddikim leatid lavo lismoach besimchato, hada hu dichtiv (tehillim la) yishmeu anavim veyismachu. rav huna amar mehacha, (tehillim 8) veyismechu chol chose vach leolam yerannenu. amar ribbi yitztzechak, hay vhay ita leatid lavo. vetana amar ribbi yose, yayin hameshumar baanavav mishsheshet yeme vereshit, ellu devarim attikim shello niglu leadam miyyom shennivra haolam, vaatidim lehittegalot latztzaddikim leatid lavo, vezo hi hashshetiya vachila, vadday da hi.

Amar ribbi yehuda beribbi shalom, im ken mahu livyatan umahu hashshor, dichtiv, ki vul harim yisu lo. amar ribbi yose, vha ketiv, (Yeshayahu 27:1) baet hahi yifkod Adonai becharbo hakkasha vhaggedola vehachazaka al livyatan nachash bariach veal livyatan nachash akalaton vharag et hattannin asher bayyam, ha hacha telata. ella remez hu deka ramaz al malkevavta. amar ribbi tanchum let lememar al ma deamru rabbanan, vadday kach hi.

Amar ribbi yitztzechak, ana havina kammeh deribbi yehoshua, veshailna hay milla, amarna, hay seudata detztzaddikaya leatid lavo i kach hu, la ityayshva belibbay, deha amar ribbi elazar, seudat hatztzaddikim leatid lavo kehay gavvna
270: (Shmuel 2 23:20) uvenayahu ben yehoyada ben ish chay dehava tzaddik venahir ledareh, kema dechay dilela nahir lealma. uvechol zimna hay beer lachay istakkal vechame, begin leitnahara kidkaamaran. vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi. hayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:11) bekachto et rivka, veyativ bahadah, veitachid immah, choshech ballayla, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat leroshi. veta chaze, yitzchak bekiryat arba hava batar demit avraham, mahu vayyeshev yitzchak im beer lachay roi, deizdavvavg beh, veachid beh behahu bera, leatara rechimuta kidkaamaran.

Patach ribbi yitzchak veamar, (Kohelet 1:Adonai) vezarach hashshemesh vva hashshemesh veel mekomo shoef zoreach hu sham. vezarach hashshemesh, da shimsha denahir lesihara, dechad itchaze bahadah keden nahara, veitnehir vezarach meatar illaa dekayyma aleh, mittamman zarach tadir. uva hashshemesh, leizdavvevga bahadah desihara. (Kohelet 1:6) holech el darom, deihu yemina veshavve tukefeh beh, uvegin detukefeh beh, kol chela degufa bimina hu uveh talya. ulevatar sovev el tzafon, nahir lesitra da venahir lesitra da. sovev sovev holech haruach, bekadmita ketiv shemesh, vehasheta ruach. ella kolla chad veraza chada, vechol da begin desihara itnahara minneh veyitchabberun tarvavyyhu.

Ta chaze, kad ata avraham lealma chavik lah lesihara vekariv lah, kevan deata yitzchak achid bah veatkif bah kedka yeut, umashich lah birchimu, kema deittemar dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:6) semolo tachat lerosh. kevan deata yaakov, keden itchabbar shimsha besihara veitnehir, veishtakkach yaakov shelim vechol sitrin, vesihara itnehirat veittakkanat bitresar shivtin.

Patach ribbi yehuda veamar (Tehillim 134:1) hinni barchu et Adonai kol avde Adonai vegomer. hay kera ukemuha, aval ta chaze, hinne barchu et Adonai, uman inun deyitchazun levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu, kol avde Adonai, begin dechol bar nash
Dichtiv, (Shemot 24:11) vayyechezu et haelohim vayyochlu vayyishtu. amar ribbi yehoshua shappir kaamar ribbi elazar, vchach hu.

Od amar ribbi yehoshua, hay mehemnuta deamru rabbanan lerubba dealma, dezamminin inun behay seudata delivyatan vehahu tora ulemishte chamra tav deitnetar mikkad itbere alma, kera ashkachu vdarshu, dichtiv, (Vayikra 26:5) vaachaltem lachmechem lasova. deamar ribbi zera, kol mine pittuy pitta hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael lehachaziram lemutav, veda hu yattir mikkullehon, deamar lehu vaachaltem lachmechem lasova. uvakkelalot, (Vayikra 26:26) vaachaltem velo tisbau, veda kashya lehu mikkullehu. may taama, dichtiv, (shamevatetaz) mi yitten mutenu beyad Adonai beeretz mitztzerayim vegomer. amar ribbi zera, melammed demishshum haachila masru nafsham lamut beyadam. kevan sheraa hakkadosh baruch hu taavatam, amar lahem, (Vayikra 26:5) im tishmeu lekol hammitztzevot, vaachaltem lasova kede lehaniach datam. kehay gavvna chamu rabbanan degaluta itmashshach, istakkemu al kerae deorayyta veamru dizminin lemechal ulemechede bisudata rabba dezammin kudesha berich hu lemebad lehu, veal da rubba dealma savlu galuta begin hahi seudata.

Amar ribbi yochanan, let lan listor mehemnuta decholla ella lekayyma leh, deha orayyta ashidat aloy, deha anan yadin mehemnuta detztzaddikaya vechissufa dilhon may hi, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:4) nagila venismecha vach, velo vaachila. (Shir HaShirim 1:4) nazkira dodecha miyyayin. vehahi seudata dizminin bah, yehe lan chulak lemehene minnah vzo hi hassimcha vehassechok. veelle toldot yitztzechak, sheyyitztzechaku hatztzaddikim leatid lavo. avraham holid et yitztzechak, zakkut hanneshama molid hassechok hazze vehassimcha baolam.
271: Bealma miyyisrael af al gav decholla yitchazun levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu, birchata divginayyhu yitbarchun illain vetattain man hi, hahi devarchin leh avde Adonai vela kullehu. uman inun devirkathon bircheta, haomdim bevet Adonai ballelot, illen inun dekayymu befalgut lelya veitare lemikre beorayyta. illen kayyme bevet Adonai ballelot, deha keden kudesha berich hu ate leishtashea im tzaddikaya beginta deeden. veanan kayyme hacha leitara bemille deorayyta, nema bemille deyitzchak, deanan beh.

Patach rabbi yitzchak veamar. (Bereshit 25:19-20) vayhi yitzchak ben arbaim shana bekachto et rivka vegomer. ben arbaim shana, ammay ata lemimne hacha dehava ben arbaim shana kad nasiv lah lerivka, ella vadday ha itkelil yitzchak betzafon vedarom, beesha umayya, ucheden hava yitzchak ben arbaim shana bekachto et rivka. kemare hakkeshet, yarok chivvavr sumak. bat shalosh shanim achid bah, kad achid bah berivka. vechad olid, olid ben shishim, leolada kedka yeut begin deyifuk yaakov shalem, mibben shishim shana kedka yeut, vechullehu achid lehu yaakov levatar, veitavid gevar shelim.

Bat betuel haarammi mippaddan aram achot lavan haarammi, may ichpat lan kule hay, deha kevar ittemar (Bereshit 24:24) uvetuel yalad et rivka vegomer, vehasheta amar bat betuel haarammi ulevatar mippadan aram, ulevatar achot lavan haarammi. ella ukemuha, dehavat ben reshaim veihi la avdat keovadayyhu, dehavat bat betuel umippadan aram, vaachot lavan, vechullehu chayyayvin leavasha, vehi salka ovadin dechashran vela avadat keovadayyhu.

Hasheta it leistakkala, i rivka havat bat esrin shenin o yattir, o bat shelosh esre, keden hu shevacha dilah dela avdat keovadayyhu, aval ad kean bat shalosh shanim havat, may shevacha dilah. amar ribbi yehuda bat shalosh shanim havat, veavidat leavda kol hahu ovada.
Amar ribbi yitzchak, af al gav dechulay hay avdat, la yedana ovadaha i inun kesheran o lav.

Vayhi yitztzechak ben arbaim shana. ribbi bo beshem ribbi yose patach vamar, (Shir HaShirim 1:2) yishshakeni minneshikot pihu vegomer, bechamma maalot nivra haolam, detaninan amar ribbi acha bar yaakov, kol ma shebbara kudesha berich hu baolamot shello chutz mimmennu hayu beshittuf. umi amar ribbi acha hachi, chas veshalom, deha bemilla da yisge pelugeta bealma, dei tema hachi, hammalachim shehem nivraim ruach hakkodesh mammash, yomar sheyyish shittuf bahem, ha kol appayyay didhon vdidan shavyayn.

Amar ribbi abba, bemilla da yisge pelugeta bealma, deha tenan bematnitin didan, dechol deavad kudesha berich hu, avad kegon gufa vnishmata, vei tema deha let gufa lammalachim, kach hu. aval let inun yachlin lemebad avidta, ad sheyyishtattef behu hahi nishmata kaddisha, dehi siyyua dilela, uvehay gavvne kol may deavid itztzetrich lehahi siyyua dilela minnih.

Amar ribbi yose, behahi shata dezammin kudesha berich hu laachaya metaya, veha sofa kol (sefer acher aktin), amikin (sefer acher attikin) bearbaim lehevi. ugezar keyaym, (Devarim 25:3) arbaim yakkennu lo yosif. sof halichatam shel yisrael bammidbar bishnat haarbaim. arbaim shana kodem techiyyayt hagguf, mamtenet lo hanneshama beeretz yisrael. bishnat haarbaim yekumun haggufot meafra. bearbaim nichla haggeshem, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 7:12) vayhi haggeshem al haaretz arbaim yom, uchetiv (Bereshit 8 6) vayhi mikketz arbaim yom vayyiftach noach. zeman geulatam shel yisrael, bishnat haarbaim hu. uvachamishshim ata yishshuv alma, dehi hayyovel. hachezarat
272: Ella, ta chaze, ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 2:2) keshoshanna ben hachochim ken raayati ben habbanot. keshoshanna, da keneset yisrael deihi ben uchelusaha kevarda ben kuvin. veraza demilla, yitzchak ate missitra deavraham deihu chesed illaa veavid chesed im kol biryayn, veaf al gav deihu dina kashya. verivka atat missitra dedina kashya veistallekat mibbenayyhu veitchabberat beyitzchak, deha rivka missitra dedina kashya atya, veaf al gav deihi missitra dedina rafya havat, vechuta dechesed tale bah veyitzchak dina kashya veihi rafya, keshoshanna ben hachochim havu. vei lav deihi rafya, la yachil alma lemisbal dina kashya deyitzchak. kegavvna da, kudesha berich hu mezavvevg ziuugin bealma, chad takkif vechad rafya begin leittakkana kolla veyitbassem alma.

Patach ribbi yehuda avatreh veamar, (Bereshit 25:21) vayyetar yitzchak laAdonai lenochach ishto. mahu vayyetar, dekariv leh karebbana, vetzalle alah. uma karbana kariv. ola kariv, dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:21) vayyeater lo Adonai, ketiv hacha vayyeater lo Adonai, uchetiv hatam (Shmuel 2 24) vayyeater elohim laaretz vegomer, ma lehallan karban af kan karban. ketiv vayyetar yitzchak, uchetiv vayyeater lo, denafak esha milleela lekovla esha diltatta.

Davar acher, vayyetar yitzchak. detzalle tzeloteh, vechatar chatira leela legabbe mazzala al benin, deha behahu atar talyayn benin, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 1:10) vattitpallel al Adonai, ucheden vayyeater lo Adonai, al tikre vayyeater lo ella vayyechater lo, chatira chatar leh kudesha berich hu, vekabbil leh, ucheden vattahar rivka ishto.

Ta chaze, esrin shenin ishtahe yitzchak im itteteh vela olidat, ad detzalle tzeloteh. begin dekudesha berich hu itrae bitzlothon detzaddikaya, beshata devaan kammeh tzelothon al ma deitzterichu. may tama, begin deyitrabbe veyittosaf revut kudesha lechol man

Hanneshama lagguf, bishnat haarbaim, shehimtina lo beeretz yisrael. hada hu dichtiv vayhi yitztzechak ben arbaim shana, shehimtin lagguf. bekachto et rivka, behachenasatah bagguf hammezuman lo. beotah shaa behachenasatah bo, en taavatam vechissufam ella lehanot mizziv hashshechina velizon mizzivah, hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:2) yishshakeni minneshikot pihu. amar ribbi abba, yishshakeni yefarneseni, sheen parnasatan ella lehanot velizon mizzivah shel mala. amar ribbi yose sofeh dikra mochach dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 1:2) ki tovim dodecha miyyayin.

Bat betuel bat bitto shel el. rav huna amar, lo chach hu, veana havit bichrakke hayyam veshamana dehavu karan lehahu garma deshiddera, hahu deishtaar bekivra mikkol gufa, betuel rammaa. sheelit aleh, amru dehu keresha (damya) dechivya, deihu rammaa, vhahu garma hu rammaa mikkol shear garme.

Detana amar ribbi shimon, hahu garma lamma ishtaar bekiyyuma ytir mikkol shear garme. mishshum deihu rammaa. velet savil taama dimzona divne nasha kishar garme, uvegine kach hu takkif mikkol garme vhu lehevi ikkera degufa itbene minneh. hada hu dichtiv bat betuel haarammi.

Vetana amar ribbi shimon, hu rammay umeolam rammay, veshachen yitztzer hara deihu rammay. hada hu dichtiv bat betuel haarammi garma rammaa. mippaddan aram, mitztzemed rammain, keditnan paddena detora shehu tzemed. achot lavan, achot yetztzer hara haarammi, keditnan, battechilla shehaya menuval bechataot baz haolam nikra lot. leatid lavo shello yehe menuval kidvekadmita, keman desache umatbil mesaavuteh, karan leh lavan. al kol panim en yitztzer hara batel min haolam.
Ta shema, dehachi anan okimna bematnitta. shete benot lot shehen shete kochot hagguf hameorrot layyitztzer hara, achshav sheeno menuval kol kach venitbal millichlucho
273: Ta chaze, avraham la tzalle kamme kudesha berich hu deyitten leh benin, af al gav desara akara havat. vei tema, ha ketiv, (Bereshit 15:3) hen li lo natatta zara, hahu lav begin tzelota hava (nusach acher hahu lo bae benin) ella keman demishtae kamme mareh. aval yitzchak tzalle al itteteh, begin deha ihu hava yada delav ihu akar ella itteteh, deyitzchak hava yada beraza dechachmeta, deyaakov zammin lemeppak minneh bitresar shivtin, aval la yada i behay itteta i beochora, veal da lenochach ishto vela lenochach rivka.

Amar hahu ravya bereh deribbi yehuda, i hachi ammay la rachim leh yitzchak leyaakov kol kach kemo leesav, hoil vehava yada dezammin ihu lekayyma minneh teresar shivtin. amar leh shappir kaamart, ella kol zina rachim leh lezineh veitmeshich veazil zina batar zineh.

Ta chaze, esav nafak sumak kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:25) vayyetze harishon admoni kullo vegomer, veihu zina deyitzchak deihu dina kashya dilela, venafak minneh esav, dina kashya letatta dedamya lezineh, vechol zina azil lezineh, veal da rachim leh leesav yattir miyyaakov kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:28) vayyeehav yitzchak et esav ki tzayid befiv. ketiv hacha ki tzayid befiv, uchetiv hatam (Bereshit 10:9) al ken yeamar kenimrod gibbor tzayid lifne Adonai.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, ketiv, (Bereshit 25:22) vayyitrotzatzu habbanim bekirebbah vattomer im ken lamma ze anochi vattelech lidrosh et Adonai, lean atar azlat. leve midresha deshem veever. vayyitrotzatzu habbanim bekirbah, detamman hava hahu rasha deesav agach kerava beh beyaakov. vayyitrotzatzu, itbaru kema deamrinan, ratzatz et mocho. itbaru da im da veitpelagu. ta chaze, da sitra derochev nachash, veda sitra derochev al karseya shelemata kaddisha besitra
Nikra lavan, votan shete banot enan betelot mammash, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 29:16) ulelavan shete vanot.

Amar ribbi yose kach hu, tamman ketiv bechira utztzeira vehacha ketiv gedola uketanna. amar ribbi yose, aval enan bechoach laasot ra ulehitorer layitztzer hara kemittechilla. mashma dichtiv shem haggedola lea, shellea mikkochah umerishatah. veshem hakketanna rachel, sheen bah koach hammitorer, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 53:7) ucherachel lifne gozzeha neelama. amar rav huna, ze yitztzer hara ushete benotav, mitchallefot mikkemot shehayu barishona. battechilla lot, mekullal menuval. achshav lavan, melubban, sheeno mekullal umenuval benivulo kevarishona. battechilla shete benotav chazakot kol achat vachat bechochah, veachshav shem haggedola lea, lea belo koach, lea belo chizzuk, lea mimmaaseha harishonim. veshem hakketanna rachel, kidkaamaran, velo kemot shehayu barishona.

Amar ribbi acha bar yaakov, ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayyetar yitztzechak laAdonai lenochach ishto ki akara hi. amar ribbi acha mippene ma hi akara, mippene sheyyetztzer hara eno nimtztza bechocho baolam, veal kach en nimtztza periyya ureviyya zulati battefilla, ma ketiv, vayyeater lo Adonai vattahar rivka ishto. kevan shemmitorer yitztzer hara, nimtztza periyya ureviyya.

Amar ribbi yose, im ken ma hefresh ben haolam haze leoto hazzeman, veod deha kera kaamar dekudesha berich hu avid. amar ribbi acha, kach hu, dekudesha berich hu itar leh lehahu inyayna detztzarich lezavvevga, vela lechol shata dihe tadir im bar nash kemo kean, deihu ishtakkach tadir vechatan beh bene nasha, ella lehahu ziuuga bilchodoy, hahi, veitaruta itaruta dekudesha berich hu lehevi, hada hu dichtiv, (Yechezkel 36:26) vahasiroti et lev haeven mibbesarchem venatatti lachem lev basar. mahu lev basar. amar ribbi yehuda, lev lehotztzi basar velo ledavar acher.
274: Veta chaze, begin deitmeshach esav avatrih dehahu nachash, azil immeh yaakov beakima, kenachash deihu chakkim, veihu azil beakimu, kema deat amer, (Bereshit 3:1) vehannachash haya arom vegomer, chakkim. veovadoy deyaakov legabbeh havu leh kenachash, vehachi itzterich leh, begin leamshacha leh leesav batreh dehahu nachash, veyitperash minneh, vela yehe leh chulaka immeh bealma den uvealma deate. vetaninan, ba lehargecha, akdim ant vekatleh. ketiv, babbeten akav et achiv deashre leh letatta, behahu akev, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 28) veyado ochezet baakev esav, deshavve yedoy al hahu akev leikkafya leh.

Davar acher veyado ochezet, dela yachil lemeppak minneh mikkol vachol, ella veyado ochezet baakev esav da sihara, deitkasseya nehora begin ekev deesav, veal da itzterich leh lemehach immeh bechachmeta, begin ledachayay leh letatta veyitdabbak beatreh.

(Bereshit 25:26) vayyikra shemo yaakov. kudesha berich hu kare leh yaakov vadday. ta chaze, ketiv, (Bereshit 27:36) hachi kara shemo yaakov, nikra shemo la ketiv, ella kara shemo. vayyaakveni, vadday chama leh kudesha berich hu deha hahu chivya kadmaa ihu chakkim leavasha, kevan deata yaakov, amar ha vadday chakkim lekovleh, uvegin kach kara leh yaakov.

Ha (102 amud alef) okimna bechol atar, vayyikra setam hay hu darga batraa, kema dichtiv, (Vayikra 1:1) vayyikra el moshe vegomer. vehacha vayyikra shemo yaakov, bechol atar shemeh la ikre (davar acher 33 ella) al yeda debar nash. beatar ochora ma ketiv, (Bereshit 33:20) vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael, kudesha berich hu kara leh leyaakov el. amar leh, ana elaha beillae veant elaha betattae.
Veta chaze, yaakov hava yada deesav hava leh leitdabbeka behahu chivya akima, veal da bechol ovadoy itmashshich aleh kechivya akima ochora,

Ribbi yitztzechak beribbi yose hava ate mikkappotkiyya lelod, paga beh ribbi yehuda. amar leh ribbi yitztzechak, tomar dachaverana chakkime matnitta itaru lehay inyayna, deyitztzer hara yitneshe min alma bar hahi shata lezivuga. amar leh, chayyeycha hachi itztzetrich yitztzer hara laolam kemitra laolam, deilmale yitztzer hara, chedvavta dishmata la lehevi, aval la menavvla kekadmita lemechete beh. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 11:9) lo yareu velo yashchitu bechol har kadshi vegomer. amar ribbi shimon, hu libba dimdoreh deyitztzer hara beh. ribbi eliezer omer, libba tava, binyayna degufa venishmeta, uvegin kach ketiv (Devarim 7:1) veahavta et Adonai elohecha bechol levavcha dehu ikkara decholla.

Kad ata rav kahana amar, hachi amrin mishshemehon demare matnitta, tere binyaynin degufa inun, kavda velibba. deamar ribbi shimon amar ribbi yehuda, kavda velibba inun menahage gufa bechol sitre evaroy, menahaga deresha mocha. aval degufa inun teren vekadmaa hu kavda, tinyayna libba. vehayeynu dichtiv befarshata, (Bereshit 28) vayyitrotztzatztzu habbanim bekirbah, illen teren binyayne degufa.

May tama vayyitrotztzatztzu. mishshum delibba (ittearu) itneshe minneh yitztzer hara. vayyitrotztzatztzu, (sheillu) vayyishlayu mibbae leh. ella amar rav huna, vayyitrotztzatztzu vayyishshevru, kelomar nishbar kocham vechelam. amar ribbi yehuda, hagguf mahu omer, im ken lamma ze anochi velamma nivretti. miyyad (Bereshit 28) vattelech lidrosh et Adonai.

(Bereshit 28) vayyomer Adonai lah sheni goyim bevitnech ushene leummim vegomer. ellu hashshene geim hakkaved vehallev. ribbi yose amar, hammoach vehallev. ribbi yehuda amar, hammoach en bichlal ze, mashma dichtiv bevitnech, vehammoach en babbeten ella barosh. ushene leummim mimmeayich vegomer, verav yaavod tzair zehu hakkaved shehu rav vegadol, vehu meshammesh lifne hallev. deamar ribbi yehuda, hakkaved kolet haddam umeshammesh bo lifne hallev.
275: Bechachmeta beakimu, vehachi itzterich. veatyay da, ki ha deamar ribbi shimon, may dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:21) vayyivra elohim et hattanninim haggedolim, da yaakov veesav. (Bereshit 1:21) veet kol nefesh hachayya haromeset, illen shear dargin devenayyhu, vadday itavid yaakov chakkim lekovleh dehahu chivya ochora vehachi itzterich.

Uvegin kach bechol yarcha veyarcha chad sair, begin leamshacha leh leatreh veyitperash min sihara. vechen beyome dechippvviri leakrava hahu sair, veda bechachma leshaltaa aleh vela yachil leavasha, dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:22) venasa hassair alav et kol avonotam el eretz gezera, veukemuha deda esav deihu sair, vecholla bechachma uverammaut legabbeh. may tama, mishshum dichtiv, (Tehillim 18:27) veim ikkesh titpattal, begin deihu chivya bisha, akim rucha, chakkim leavasha, aste leela veaste letatta.

Uvegin kach, yisrael mekaddemin vechakkemin leh bechachma, beakimu, begin dela yachil leavasha uleshaltaa. veal da yaakov deihu beraza dimhemnuta, kol ovadoy legabbe deesav begin dela yahav ducheta leh lehahu chivya, lesaava makdesha. vela yakriv legabbeh, vela yishlot bealma. veal da la itzterich leh leavraham leitnahaga beukema, vela leyitzchak, begin deesav deihu sitra dehahu chivya, ad la ata lealma. aval yaakov, deihu mareh (21 amud bet) deveta, ibbae leh lekayyma lekovleh dehahu chivya, dela yahiv leh shaltanuta kelal lesaava be makdesha deyaakov. veal da itzterich leyaakov yattir mikkol bene alma. uvegin kach yisrael kaddishin itberiru chulak adveh dekudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Devarim 32:9) ki chelek Adonai ammo yaakov chevel nachalato.

(Bereshit 25:25) vayyetztze harishon admoni. amar rav kahana, hakkaved hu harishon vehu admoni. lamma hu admoni, al shebbolea et haddam techilla. ribbi eliezr omer, lamma nikra shemo rishon, al shehu rishon livloa haddam mikkol hammaachol, vhu rishon laddam aval lo laytztzira. uveman nokim verav yaavod tzair, al shehu rav vegadol beshiuro min hallev vhu oved lallev. amar ribbi abba, lamma ata parshata da, ella leachazaa livne alma deaf al gav dehahi shelemuta lehevi beara, archeh vetiveh dealma la ishtanne. ribbi yisa amar bo uree hakkaved hu hatztzad tzayid vehu tzayid befiv, vhallev hu hachoshev vhu (Bereshit 25:28) yoshev ohalim hada hu dichtiv (Bereshit 28) vayyazed yaakov nazid. choshev machashavot, nose venoten battora.

Vayyazed yaakov nazid. ribbi ba beshem ribbi acha amar, leolam tivo shel olam eno mishtanne, bo uree, ma ketiv, vayyazed yaakov nazid, kema deat amer asher zadu alehem vetargumo dechashivu. kelomar hallev choshev umeharher battora biydiat boru. ma ketiv, vayyavo esav min hassade. vehu ayyef. hakkaved shederech tivu latztzet velatztzud tzayid befiv livloa veeno motztze, nikra ayyef. vehu omer lalev, ad sheatta mehareher biddevarim ellu bedivre tora, hareher baachila uvishtiya lekayyem gufecha. hada hu dichtiv, vayyomer esav el yaakov halitni na min haadom haadom hazze, ki chen darki livloa haddam uleshagger lishar haevarim. ki ayyif anochi, bela achila ushetiyya. vehallev omer, ten li harishon vehamuvechar mikkol ma shetivla, ten li bechoratcha, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:31) michra chayyom et bechoratcha li, konmita detaiva. ad shehallev mehareher vechoshev bammaachol, bolea hakkaved. deilmale hahu kissufa vhirhura delibba bammaachol, lo yuchelu hakkaved vehaevarim livloa
276: Deamar ribbi yose, ken derech haavadim, sheenam ochlim ad shehaadon ochel.

Amar ribbi yose, ketiv leachar ken, (Bereshit 25:34) veyaakov natan leesav lechem unezid adashim. mahu adashim, segalgallin kegulgalta, vegalgalla saviv bealma. kelomar, dela itneshe mearcheh. kach hu bar nash, behahu zimna af al gav dechol hahu tivu vikar ushelemuta lehevi, archeh dealma lemechal ulemishte la yitneshe.

Matnitin, tenan arba ruchot haolam menashshevan, veatid kudesha berich hu lehitorer ruach echad lekayyim hagguf, sheyhe kelul mid ruchot. hada hu dichtiv (Yechezkel 37:9) mearba ruchot boi haruach. bearba la ketiv ella mearba ruchot haolam, sheyhe kalul mearbatam. vetana, oto haruach hu ruach hammolid, hu haruach haochel veshote. veen ben haolam hazze limot hammashiach, ella shibud malchuyyot bilvad. veen ben olam hazze, litchiyyayt hammetim ella nekiyyut vhassagat yedia. rav nachman amar vearichut yamim.

Amar rav yosef vchi yemot hammashiach utechiyyayt hammetim lav chad hu. amar leh, lo. ditnan, bet hammikdash kodem lekibbutz galuyyot, kibbutz galuyyot, kodem litchiyyayt hammetim, utechiyyayt hammetim hu acharon shebbechullam. mena lan, dichtiv (Tehillim 147:2-3) bone yerushalami Adonai nidche yisrael yechannes harofe lishvure lev umechabbesh leatztzevotam. zo hi techiyyayt hammetim, shehi harfua lishvure lev al metehem. bone yerushalami techilla, veacharav nidche yisrael yechannes, veharofe lishvure lev acharon al hakkol.

Tenan, 40 shana kodem hakkibbutz galuyyot litchiyyayt hammetim, kidamrinan vayhi yitztzechak ben arbaim shana. hay 40 shana, may avidtayyhu. amar rav kahana amar ribbi beroka, mikkibbutz galuyyot ad techiyyayt hammetim, kamma tzarot, kamma milchamot yitorru al yisrael, veashre hannimlat mehem, dichtiv,
Da lesitra dimhemnuta veda lesitra deavoda zara.

Vechen hava bemeoy derivka, detamman kol chad azil lesitreh. dechad ihi ishtaddelat beovadin dechashran o avarat semich leatar tav lemebad pikkude deorayyta, hava yaakov chade vedachik lenafka, vechad havavt azla semich leatar avoda zara, hahu rasha batash lenafka, veukemuha. uvegin kach, kad itberiu unefaku lealma, kol chad itperash veazil veitmeshach beducheteh deitchaze leh, veal da, (Bereshit 25:27) vayyigdelu hannearim vayhi esav ish yodea tzayid vegomer.

(Bereshit 25:28) vayyeehav yitzchak et esav ki tzayid befiv, ha ukemuha, (kema) dichtiv, ish yodea tzayid ish sade. uchetiv hatam, (Bereshit 10:9) hu haya gibbor tzayid (davar acher 33 may) ish sade, lekappecha lon livne nasha ulekatla lon, veihu amar deavid tzelota vetzayyid leh befumeh. ish sade, begin dechulak adveh lav ihi beyishshuva, ella beatar charuv. bemadbera, bechakla, veal da ish sade.

Vei tema, hech la yada yitzchak kol ovadoy bishin deesav, veha shechinta havat immeh, dei la sharya immeh shechinta, hech yachil levarcha leh leyaakov beshata devarcheh. ella vadday shechinta havat dayyra immeh beveta vedayyra immeh tadir, aval la oda leh, begin deyitbarech yaakov bela dateh ella bedateh dekudesha berich hu. vehachi itzterich, divhahi shata deal yaakov kamme avuhi alat immeh shechinta. ucheden chama bedatoy yitzchak deitchaze livracha, veyitberich middata dishchinta.

Ta chaze, (sefer acher zimna chada, hava yativ rabbi shimon ushear chavrayyay, al kammeh rabbi elazar bereh. amehav leh lerabbi shimon, milleta rabbeta bainan lemive kammach baanayynea deyaakov veasu. ech lo baa yaakov lemehav leesav tavshil ditlofchin ad dezaven leh becheruta dileh, veod deamar asu leyitzchak avuhi, vayyakeveni ze peamim.

Amar lon, bahaden shaata, attun chayyayvim lekabbela malkot. daheamenatevan lefitgame deesav vashekaretaven lefitgame deyaakov, deha kera ashid aleh, (Bereshit 25:27) veyaakov ish tam. vetu ketiv, (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov. ella, kach hu aneyynayh deyaakov im asu, begin deesav hava sane labekayravetaa bekadmita, vahava bae minneh deyaakov dalesabeh leh afillu belo kesef. hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:34) veyochal vayyesht vayyakam vayyelech vayyivez asu et habbechora).

(Bereshit 25:29) vayyazed yaakov nazid vayyavo esav min hassade vehu ayef. amar ribbi elazar, vayyazed yaakov, ha ukemuha deha begin aveluta deavraham hava, aval vayyazed yitzchak nazid mibbae leh, ela vayyazed yaakov nazid, deihu hava yada ikkara
277: (Daniel 12:1) baet hahi yimmalet ammecha kol hannimtztza katuv bassefer. ribbi yehuda amar mehacha, (Daniel 12:1) yitbarru veyitlabbenu veyitztzarfu rabbim. ribbi yitztzechak amar mehacha, (Zecharya 13:9) utztzeraftim kitztzerof et hakkesef uvechantim kivchon et hazzahav. uveotam hayyamim, yihyu yamim asher yomru (Kohelet 12:1) en li bahem chefetz, umishshaa sheyyaavru hatztzarot ad techiyyayt hammetim 40 shana.

Rav huna amar, ta chaze (Yehoshua Adonai:6) ki arbaim shana halchu bene yisrael bammidbar vegomer asher lo shamu bekol Adonai, kehay gavvna (gufa) hacha. amar ribbi yosef, kol illen chad milla amru, ulesof 40 shana shehatztzarot yaavru veharshaim yichlu, yichyu hammetim shochni afar. may taama, mishshum dichtiv, (Nachum 1:9) lo takum paamayim tzara, vday lahem bamme sheavru. umizzeman techiyyayt hammetim, yityyshev alma beyishshuvo, hada hu dichtiv, (Zecharya 14:9) bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad.

Rabbi elazar ben arach, hava yativ, vhav ka mitztzetaer benafshoy tafe al lekame rabbi yehoshua. amar leh chezu nehiruv butztzina dealma lama chashochan. amar leh, chezu uddechilu sagi al be, deha ana chame ma deitaru chavrana mare matnitta, desharat alayyhu ruach kaddishin. vehahu deitaru, devshetitae yehe purekana, shappir. aval ana chame orka yetera al inun dayyra afra, divelef shetitae lizman (Shemot 10 amud alef) arba meot utemanya shenin minneh, yihyu kayymin kol dayyre afra bekiyyumehon. uvegine kach itaru chaverana, al pesuka dekara lon bene chet, chet, deyitarun lecht shana, vehayeynu dichtiv, (Vayikra 25:13) bishnat hayyovel hazzot tashuvu ish el achuzato. kesheyyishtallem hazzot, shehu chameshet alafim varba meot utemanya, tashuvu ish el achuzato, el nishmato, shehi achuzato vnachalato.
(Od) amar ribbi yehoshua lo tikshe lach hay, deha taninan 3 kittot hen, shel tzaddikim gemurim vshel reshaim gemurim veshel benonim.

Dileh, behahu sitra deitdabbak beh, uvegin kach avad tavshilin sumekin. adashim, tavshil sumeka, detavshila da mitbar chela vetukefa dedama sumeka bagin letabbara tukefeh vecheleh. uvegin kach, avad leh bechachmeta, kehahu gavvna sumeka.

Veal hahu tavshila izdabban leh leavda vezabbin becheruteh leyaakov. uvehahi shata yada yaakov divgin sair chad deyikrevun yisrael legabbe darga dileh, yithappach leavda livnoy vela yekatreg lon. uvecholla azal yaakov legabbe deesav bechachma, begin hahu darga chakkim deesav, vela yachil leshaltaa veitkafya vela istaav (beh) beteh veihu yagin aleh.

(Chaser, umetzaanu besifra acharina 43 vayyomer asu el yaakov 0 haleiteni na min haadam haadam hazze. amay ketiv tere zimne haadom, ella, begin dechol ma deit beh edom, kema deat amar 1 vayyetze harishon admoni. vatebasheylev edom dichtiv min haadom haadom hazze, veara dileh aduma dichtiv 2 artza sair sade edom, veguverin dileh adummin dichtiv, 3 hu asu avi edom. uman dezammin leitpara minneh edom dichtiv 4 dodi tzach veedom, ulevusheh edom dichtiv, 5 maddua edom lilvushecha, uchetiv 6 mi ze ba meedom).

Amar ribbi yehuda, vechen belavan itchaze hachi, begin deha ihu chorasha hava, kema dichtiv (Bereshit 30:27) nichashti vayvaracheni Adonai biglalecha, veaf al gav deyaakov ikre gevar shelim, begin kach hava shelim im man deitzterich leh lemehach immeh berachame hava azil, veim man deitzterich lemehach imeh bedina kashya uvaakimu hava azil, begin ditre (146 amud alef) chulake havu beh, vealeh ketiv, (Tehillim 18:27) im chasid titchassad veim ikkesh titpattal. im chasid besitra dechesed, veim ikkesh besitra dedina kashya, kolla kedka yeut.

(Bereshit 26:1) vayhi raav baaretz millevad haraav harishon vegomer. rabbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 11:5) Adonai tzaddik yivchan verasha veohev (600 nachash) chamas sana nafsho. kamma ovadoy dekudesha berich hu mittaknan, vechol ma deihu avid kolla al dina ukeshot, kema dichtiv, (Devarim lak) hatztzur tamim poolo ki chol derachav mishpat el emuna veen avel tzaddik veyashar hu.

Ta chaze, la dan kudesha berich hu leadam kadmaa ad depakkid le letoalteh, dela yiste libbeh ureuteh leorach ochora begin dela yistaav. veihu la istammar, veavar al pikkude demareh ulevatar ken dan leh dina.
278: Tzaddikim gemurim yekumun bekima shel mete eretz yisrael, mehayyom kamma shanim, shehem kodmim battechilla, bishnat haarbaim shel kibbutz galuyyot. vehaacharonim kullam, lizman arba meot ushemone shana leelef hashshishshi, kidkaamaran. man yizke lehay arka, man yitkayyim bekiyyum dateh ben hay zimna, veal da itztzetaerna benafshay.

Amar leh, ribbi, ha taninan, (Bereshit 1:3) yehi or, yehi raz. chazar vamar, bitshuva yitkaddam kolla. amar ribbi yehoshua, i lav deamart hachi, achsimna pumin lemitztzepe purekana kol yoma, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:6) chosen yeshuot. mahu yeshuot, ellu hametztzappim yeshuot bechol yom.

Ma hu datoy deribbi elazar. hayeynu dichtiv, (Daniel 12:2) verabbim misheni admat afar yakitztzu. mashma dichtiv mishene ellu hem hatztzaddikim hannikdamim bechayyihem kodem ze. vechamma shanim hem nikdamim, ribbi yehuda omer matayim veeser shanim. ribbi yitztzechak omer, 214 shana, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 24:19) veyird miyyaakov vegomer. 214 shana nikdamim hatztzaddikim lishshear kol adam. rav nachman amar, lefi hashshiur shennivla beafar. amar leh ribbi yose, im ken harebe techiyyot havu, ella kol hattechiyyot yihyu beoto hazzeman, vhay deittemar bechazon (Daniel 10:1) veemet haddavar vetztzava gadol.

(Bereshit 26:1) vayhi raav baaretz millevad haraav harishon asher haya bime avraham. ribbi abbahu patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 1:12) ad shehammelech bimsibbo nirdi natan recho. detaninan, arba tekufot vearba zemannim meshunim zo mizzo yaavru hatztzaddikim leatid lavo. haechad, oto zeman yisge hachachma baolam veyassigu hassaga ma shello hissigu baz haolam. detaninan, amar ribbi pinchas, hassagat hatztzaddikim leatid lavo, yoter mimmalache hashsharet dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 11:9) kammayim layyam mechassim. hashsheni titassekun (chaser) (74 kan midrash hannelam)

(Bereshit 25:27) vayyigdelu hannearim. sitra deavraham garim lon leitgaddala uzechuteh siyyay lon, hu hava mechannech lon bemitzvot, dichtiv, (Bereshit 18:19) ki yedativ lemaan asher yetzavve et banav vegomer, leasgaa yaakov veesav. (Bereshit 25:27) vayyigdelu hannearim vayhi esav ish yodea tzayid vegomer. amar ribbi elazar, kol chad vechad itperash learcheh,
Veim kol da, la dan leh kedka chaze leh, veorich immeh rugezeh veitkeyyaym yoma chad deihu elef shenin, bar inun shivim shanim demasar leh ledavid malka dela hava leh miggarmeh kelum.

Kegavvna da, la dan leh lebar nash keovadoy bishin deihu avid tadir, dei hachi la yachil alma leitkayyma, ella kudesha berich hu arich rugezeh im tzaddikaya, veim rashshiaya yattir mitztzaddikaya. im rashshiaya begin dituvun bityuveta shelemata, deyitkayymun behay alma uvealma deate. kema dichtiv, (Yechezkel 33:11) chay ani neum Adonai vegomer im echpotz vegomer ki im beshuv rasha middarko vechaya. vechaya bealma den, vechaya bealma deate, veal da orich rugezeh lon tadir. o begin deyippuk minnehon giza tava bealma kema deappik avraham mitterach deihu giza tava, vesharasha vechulaka tava lealma.

Aval kudesha berich hu medakdek im tzaddikaya tadir, bechol ovadin deinun avdin. begin deyada dela yistun leyamina usemala, uvegin kach avchin lon. lav begineh, deha ihu yada yitzra vetukefa dimhemnuta dilhon, ella begin laarama rishehon beginayyhu.

Kegavvna da, avad leh leavraham, dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:1) vehaelohim nissa et avraham. may nissa, haramat nes. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 62:10) harimu nes, (Yirmeyahu 4:6) seu nes, arim digla dileh bechol alma, veaf al gav deha ittemar, begin da kudesha berich hu arim digla deavraham beenehon decholla, hada hu dichtiv nissa et avraham, uf hachi kudesha berich hu begin laarama digla detzaddikaya ihu bachin lon, laarama reshayyhu bechol alma.

(Tehillim 11:5) tzaddik yivchan, may tama, amar ribbi shimon begin dekudesha berich hu kad itrae behu betzaddikaya, ma ketiv, (Yeshayahu 53:10) vaAdonai chafetz dakkeo hecholi. veukemuha. aval begin diruta dekudesha berich hu, la itrae ella benishmata, aval begufa la, deha nishmata ihi damya lenishmata dilela, vegufa lav ihu chaze leitachada leela, veaf al gav dediukena degufa beraza illaa
279: Veta chaze, bezimna dekudesha berich hu itrae benishmateh debar nash, leithannaa (nusach acher leitnahara) vah, mache legufa begin detishlot nishmata. deha beod denishmata im gufa, nishmata la yachla leshaltaa. dechad itra (nusach acher itbar) gufa, nishmata shalta. tzaddik yivchan, may tzaddik yivchan, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 28:16) even bochan, hachi name tzaddik yivchan, atkif leh. kehay even bochan, dehi (Yeshayahu 28:16) pinnat yikrat, hachi name tzaddik yivchan.

Verasha veohev chamas sana nafsho. may sana nafsho, salleka datach dekudesha berich hu have denafsho sana lehahu rasha. ella hahu darga dechol nishmatin talyayn beh, sana nafsho dehahu rasha, dela baya lah kelal. la baya lah la bealma den vela bealma deate. uvegin kach ketiv, (Tehillim 11:5) verasha veohev chamas sana nafsho, vadday. davar acher sana nafsho, kema deat amer, (Amos 6:8) nishba adonay Adonai benafsho, uvegin kach tzaddik yivchan.

Ta chaze, kad bara kudesha berich hu leadam, pakkid leh leotava leh, yahav leh chachmeta, istallak bedargoy leela. kad nachat letatta, chama tiuveta deyetzer hara veitdabbak beh, veinshe kol ma deistallak (sefer acher deistakkal), bikara illaa demareh.

Ata noach, bekadmita ketiv, (Bereshit 6:9) noach ish tzaddik tamim haya, ulevatar nachat letatta, vechama chamra takkif, dela tzalel, mechad yoma, veishte minneh, veishtakkar veitgeli, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:21) vayyesht min hayyayin vayyishkar vayyitgal betoch oholo.

Ata avraham, istallak bechachmeta, veistakkal bikara demareh, levatar (Bereshit 12:10) vayhi raav baaretz vayyered avram ymitzrayma lagur sham ki chaved haraav baaretz vegomer. levatar ma ketiv, (Bereshit 13:1) vayyaal avram mimitzrayim hu veishto vechol asher lo velot immo hannegba, veistallak ledargeh kadmaa dehava beh bekadmita, veal bishlam venafak bishlam.

Ata yitzchak, ma ketiv, (Bereshit 26:1) vayhi raav baaretz millevad haraav harishon vegomer. veazal yitzchak veistallak mittamman levatar bishlam. vechullehu tzaddikayay, kullehu bachin lon kudesha berich hu, begin laarama reshayyhu bealma den uvealma deate.

(Bereshit 26:7) vayyishalu anshe hammakom leishto vayyomer achoti hi, kema deamar avraham begin dishchinta hava immeh veim itteteh, uvegin shechinta kaamar, dichtiv, (Mishlei 7:4) emor lachachma achoti at. veal da ittakkaf veamar achoti hi. tu, avraham veyitzchak, hachi itchaze, devadday begin kera dichtiv (Shir HaShirim Adonai:2) achoti raayati yonati tammati, uvegin kach vadday itchaze lon lomar, achoti hi, veal da ittakkafu tzaddikayay beh bekudesha berich hu.

(Bereshit 26:8) vayhi ki archu lo sham hayyamim vegomer. et rivka ishto dayyka, (veda shechinta, kema daavoda zara ketiv bah 1 vayyakumu letzachek hachi nammi metzachek et) da shechinta dehavat immah derivka. davar acher, vechi salleka datach deyitzchak hava meshammesh arseh bimama, deha taninan yisrael kaddishin inun vela meshamshe arsayyhu bimama, veyitzchak dehava kaddish, hava meshammesh arseh bimama.

Ella, vadday avimelech chakkim hava, veihu istakkal beitztagninuta dileh, deihu challon. ketiv hacha (Bereshit 26:8) bead hachallon, uchetiv hatam (Shoftim Adonai:28) bead hachallon nishkafa vatteyabbev em sisra, ma lehallan beitztagninuta, uf hachi name beitztagninuta, vechama dela hava kema dehava amar yitzchak. ella vadday ihu metzachek immah, veihi itteteh. ucheden (Bereshit 26:9) vayyikra avimelech leyitzchak vayyomer vegomer. ribbi yose amar, yaot hava avimelech lemebad leyitzchak kema deavad leavraham, bar deha ochach leh kudesha berich hu bekadmita.

Ta chaze, ketiv ki amarti rak en yirat elohim bammakom hazze, amar ribbi abba, begin kach amar achoti hi, begin leitdabbaka bishchinta, dichtiv, (Mishlei 7:4) emor lachachma achoti at. may tama, begin debhu la hava mehemnuta, dei mehemnuta ishtakkach benayyhu, la hava itzterich. aval miggo dela hava benayyhu mehemnuta, amar hachi. uvegin kach amar (Bereshit 20:11) ki amarti rak en yirat elohim
